verses.english: Any food that may be eaten, on which water comes, shall become unclean, and any drink that may be drunk in any vessel shall become unclean.
verses.hebrew: מִכָּל־הָאֹכֶל אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל אֲשֶׁר יָבוֹא עָלָיו מַיִם יִטְמָא וְכָל־מַשְׁקֶה אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׁתֶה בְּכָל־כְּלִי יִטְמָא׃

verses.english: Anything on which any of their carcasses falls shall become unclean. An oven or stove shall be demolished; they are unclean and shall be unclean for you.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִפֹּל מִנִּבְלָתָם עָלָיו יִטְמָא תַּנּוּר וְכִירַיִם יֻתָּץ טְמֵאִים הֵם וּטְמֵאִים יִהְיוּ לָכֶם׃

verses.english: But a spring or cistern collecting water shall remain clean; whoever touches their carcasses shall become unclean.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ מַעְיָן וּבוֹר מִקְוֵה־מַיִם יִהְיֶה טָהוֹר וְנֹגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָם יִטְמָא׃

verses.english: If any of their carcasses falls on seed intended for sowing, it remains clean.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יִפֹּל מִנִּבְלָתָם עַל־כָּל־זֶרַע זֵרוּעַ אֲשֶׁר יִזָּרֵעַ טָהוֹר הוּא׃

verses.english: But if water is put on the seed and any of their carcasses falls on it, it is unclean for you.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יֻתַּן־מַיִם עַל־זֶרַע וְנָפַל מִנִּבְלָתָם עָלָיו טָמֵא הוּא לָכֶם׃

verses.english: If an animal that you may eat dies, whoever touches its carcass shall be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי יָמוּת מִן־הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר־הִיא לָכֶם לְאָכְלָה הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּנִבְלָתָהּ יִטְמָא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Whoever eats from its carcass shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening. Whoever carries its carcass shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְהָאֹכֵל מִנִּבְלָתָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב וְהַנֹּשֵׂא אֶת־נִבְלָתָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth is detestable; it shall not be eaten.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל־הָאָרֶץ שֶׁקֶץ הוּא לֹא יֵאָכֵל׃

verses.english: Whatever moves on its belly, whatever walks on four, or whatever has many feet, among all the creeping things that creep upon the earth, you shall not eat, for they are detestable.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל הוֹלֵךְ עַל־גָּחוֹן וְכֹל הוֹלֵךְ עַל־אַרְבַּע עַד כָּל־מַרְבֵּה רַגְלַיִם לְכָל־הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ עַל־הָאָרֶץ לֹא תֹאכְלוּם כִּי־שֶׁקֶץ הֵם׃

verses.english: Do not make yourselves detestable through any creeping thing that creeps. Do not make yourselves unclean through them and so become defiled by them.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּשַׁקְּצוּ אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בְּכָל־הַשֶּׁרֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵץ וְלֹא תִטַּמְּאוּ בָּהֶם וְנִטְמֵתֶם בָּם׃

verses.english: For I am YHWH your God. Consecrate yourselves and be holy, for I am holy. Do not defile yourselves through any creeping thing that moves upon the earth.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אָנִי וְלֹא תְטַמְּאוּ אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בְּכָל־הַשֶּׁרֶץ הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: For I am YHWH who brings you up from the land of Egypt to be your God. You shall be holy, for I am holy.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה הַמַּעֲלֶה אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אָנִי׃

verses.english: This is the law of animals, birds, every living creature that moves in the waters, and every creature that creeps upon the earth,
verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַבְּהֵמָה וְהָעוֹף וְכֹל נֶפֶשׁ הַחַיָּה הָרֹמֶשֶׂת בַּמָּיִם וּלְכָל־נֶפֶשׁ הַשֹּׁרֶצֶת עַל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: to distinguish between the unclean and the clean, and between the creature that may be eaten and the creature that may not be eaten.
verses.hebrew: לְהַבְדִּיל בֵּין הַטָּמֵא וּבֵין הַטָּהֹר וּבֵין הַחַיָּה הַנֶּאֱכֶלֶת וּבֵין הַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵאָכֵל׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: If a woman conceives and gives birth to a male, she shall be unclean for seven days; as in the days of her menstrual separation, she shall be unclean.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר אִשָּׁה כִּי תַזְרִיעַ וְיָלְדָה זָכָר וְטָמְאָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כִּימֵי נִדַּת דְּוֺתָהּ תִּטְמָא׃

verses.english: On the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִמּוֹל בְּשַׂר עָרְלָתוֹ׃

verses.english: She shall remain thirty-three days in the blood of purification. She shall touch nothing holy and shall not enter the sanctuary until the days of her purification are completed.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּשֵׁב בִּדְמֵי טָהֳרָה בְּכָל־קֹדֶשׁ לֹא־תִגָּע וְאֶל־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא תָבֹא עַד־מְלֹאת יְמֵי טָהֳרָהּ׃

verses.english: If she gives birth to a female, she shall be unclean for two weeks as in her menstrual separation, and remain sixty-six days in the blood of purification.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־נְקֵבָה תֵלֵד וְטָמְאָה שְׁבֻעַיִם כְּנִדָּתָהּ וְשִׁשִּׁים יוֹם וְשֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּשֵׁב עַל־דְּמֵי טָהֳרָה׃

verses.english: When the days of her purification for a son or daughter are completed, she shall bring to the priest at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting a year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or turtledove for a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וּבִמְלֹאת יְמֵי טָהֳרָהּ לְבֵן אוֹ לְבַת תָּבִיא כֶּבֶשׂ בֶּן־שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָה וּבֶן־יוֹנָה אוֹ־תֹר לְחַטָּאת אֶל־פֶּתַח אֹהֶל־מוֹעֵד אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: He shall present it before YHWH and make atonement for her, and she shall be clean from the source of her blood. This is the law for a woman who gives birth to a male or female.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיבוֹ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלֶיהָ וְטָהֲרָה מִמְּקֹר דָּמֶיהָ זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַיֹּלֶדֶת לַזָּכָר אוֹ לַנְּקֵבָה׃

verses.english: If she cannot afford a sheep, she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and one for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא תִמְצָא יָדָהּ דֵּי שֶׂה וְלָקְחָה שְׁתֵּי־תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה אֶחָד לְעֹלָה וְאֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן וְטָהֵרָה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: If anyone has a swelling, a scab, or a bright spot on the skin of his body, and it becomes a lesion of leprosy on his skin, he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.
verses.hebrew: אָדָם כִּי־יִהְיֶה בְעוֹר־בְּשָׂרוֹ שְׂאֵת אוֹ־סַפַּחַת אוֹ בַהֶרֶת וְהָיָה בְעוֹר־בְּשָׂרוֹ לְנֶגַע צָרָעַת וְהוּבָא אֶל־אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אוֹ אֶל־אַחַד מִבָּנָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים׃

verses.english: The priest shall examine the lesion on the skin of his body. If the hair in the lesion has turned white and the lesion appears deeper than the skin of his body, it is a lesion of leprosy. The priest shall examine him and declare him unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַנֶּגַע בְּעוֹר־הַבָּשָׂר וְשֵׂעָר בַּנֶּגַע הָפַךְ לָבָן וּמַרְאֵה הַנֶּגַע עָמֹק מֵעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ נֶגַע צָרַעַת הוּא וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וְטִמֵּא אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: If the bright spot on his skin is white but does not appear deeper than the skin, and its hair has not turned white, the priest shall isolate the affected person for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בַּהֶרֶת לְבָנָה הִוא בְּעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ וְעָמֹק אֵין־מַרְאֶהָ מִן־הָעוֹר וּשְׂעָרָה לֹא־הָפַךְ לָבָן וְהִסְגִּיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַנֶּגַע שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: On the seventh day the priest shall examine him. If the lesion remains unchanged in his eyes and has not spread in the skin, the priest shall isolate him for another seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְהִנֵּה הַנֶּגַע עָמַד בְּעֵינָיו לֹא־פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בָּעוֹר וְהִסְגִּירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שֵׁנִית׃

verses.english: On the seventh day the priest shall examine him again. If the lesion has faded and has not spread in the skin, the priest shall declare him clean; it is a scab. He shall wash his garments and be clean.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֹתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שֵׁנִית וְהִנֵּה כֵּהָה הַנֶּגַע וְלֹא־פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בָּעוֹר וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן מִסְפַּחַת הִיא וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָהֵר׃

verses.english: But if the scab spreads in the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה הַמִּסְפַּחַת בָּעוֹר אַחֲרֵי הֵרָאֹתוֹ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן לְטָהֳרָתוֹ וְנִרְאָה שֵׁנִית אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: The priest shall examine him, and if the scab has spread in the skin, the priest shall declare him unclean; it is leprosy.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה פָּשְׂתָה הַמִּסְפַּחַת בָּעוֹר וְטִמְּאוֹ הַכֹּהֵן צָרַעַת הִוא׃

verses.english: When a lesion of leprosy occurs in anyone, he shall be brought to the priest.
verses.hebrew: נֶגַע צָרַעַת כִּי תִהְיֶה בְּאָדָם וְהוּבָא אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: The priest shall examine him. If there is a white swelling in the skin, which has turned the hair white, and raw living flesh in the swelling,
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה שְׂאֵת־לְבָנָה בָּעוֹר וְהִיא הָפְכָה שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּמִחְיַת בָּשָׂר חַי בַּשְׂאֵת׃

verses.english: it is longstanding leprosy on the skin of his body. The priest shall declare him unclean; he shall not isolate him, for he is unclean.
verses.hebrew: צָרַעַת נוֹשֶׁנֶת הִוא בְּעוֹר בְּשָׂרוֹ וְטִמְּאוֹ הַכֹּהֵן לֹא יַסְגִּרֶנּוּ כִּי טָמֵא הוּא׃

verses.english: If the leprosy breaks out over the skin and covers all the affected person’s skin from head to foot, wherever the priest can see,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־פָּרוֹחַ תִּפְרַח הַצָּרַעַת בָּעוֹר וְכִסְּתָה הַצָּרַעַת אֵת כָּל־עוֹר הַנֶּגַע מֵרֹאשׁוֹ וְעַד־רַגְלָיו לְכָל־מַרְאֵה עֵינֵי הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: the priest shall examine him. If the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall declare the affected person clean; it has all turned white, and he is clean.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה כִסְּתָה הַצָּרַעַת אֶת־כָּל־בְּשָׂרוֹ וְטִהַר אֶת־הַנָּגַע כֻּלּוֹ הָפַךְ לָבָן טָהוֹר הוּא׃

verses.english: But whenever raw living flesh appears on him, he shall be unclean.
verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם הֵרָאוֹת בּוֹ בָּשָׂר חַי יִטְמָא׃

verses.english: The priest shall examine the raw living flesh and declare him unclean. The raw living flesh is unclean; it is leprosy.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי וְטִמְּאוֹ הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי טָמֵא הוּא צָרַעַת הוּא׃

verses.english: But if the raw living flesh changes and turns white, he shall come to the priest.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ כִי יָשׁוּב הַבָּשָׂר הַחַי וְנֶהְפַּךְ לְלָבָן וּבָא אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: The priest shall examine him. If the lesion has turned white, the priest shall declare the affected person clean; he is clean.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה נֶהְפַּךְ הַנֶּגַע לְלָבָן וְטִהַר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַנֶּגַע טָהוֹר הוּא׃

verses.english: If a boil occurs on the skin of the body and heals,
verses.hebrew: וּבָשָׂר כִּי־יִהְיֶה בוֹ־בְעֹרוֹ שְׁחִין וְנִרְפָּא׃

verses.english: and a white swelling or a reddish-white bright spot appears in the place of the boil, he shall show himself to the priest.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בִּמְקוֹם הַשְּׁחִין שְׂאֵת לְבָנָה אוֹ בַהֶרֶת לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדָּמֶת וְנִרְאָה אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: The priest shall examine it. If it appears lower than the skin and its hair has turned white, the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a lesion of leprosy that has broken out in the boil.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה מַרְאֶהָ שָׁפָל מִן־הָעוֹר וּשְׂעָרָהּ הָפַךְ לָבָן וְטִמְּאוֹ הַכֹּהֵן נֶגַע־צָרַעַת הִוא בַּשְּׁחִין פָּרָחָה׃

verses.english: But if the priest examines it and finds no white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin but has faded, the priest shall isolate him for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִרְאֶנָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה אֵין־בָּהּ שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּשְׁפָלָה אֵינֶנָּה מִן־הָעוֹר וְהִיא כֵהָה וְהִסְגִּירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: If it spreads in the skin, the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a lesion.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה בָּעוֹר וְטִמֵּא הַכֹּהֵן אֹתוֹ נֶגַע הִוא׃

verses.english: But if the bright spot stays in its place and does not spread, it is the scar of the boil; the priest shall declare him clean.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־תַּחְתֶּיהָ תַּעֲמֹד הַבַּהֶרֶת לֹא פָשָׂתָה צָרֶבֶת הַשְּׁחִין הִוא וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: Or if the skin of the body has a burn from fire, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a reddish-white or white bright spot,
verses.hebrew: אוֹ בָשָׂר כִּי־יִהְיֶה בְעֹרוֹ מִכְוַת־אֵשׁ וְהָיְתָה מִחְיַת הַמִּכְוָה בַּהֶרֶת לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדֶּמֶת אוֹ לְבָנָה׃

verses.english: the priest shall examine it. If the hair in the bright spot has turned white and it appears deeper than the skin, it is leprosy that has broken out in the burn. The priest shall declare him unclean; it is a lesion of leprosy.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה אֹתָהּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה נֶהְפַּךְ שֵׂעָר לָבָן בַּבַּהֶרֶת וּמַרְאֶהָ עָמֹק מִן־הָעוֹר צָרַעַת הִוא בַּמִּכְוָה פָּרָחָה וְטִמֵּא אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן נֶגַע צָרַעַת הִוא׃

verses.english: But if the priest examines it and finds no white hair in the bright spot, and it is not lower than the skin but has faded, the priest shall isolate him for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִרְאֶנָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה אֵין־בַּבֶּהֶרֶת שֵׂעָר לָבָן וּשְׁפָלָה אֵינֶנָּה מִן־הָעוֹר וְהִוא כֵהָה וְהִסְגִּירוֹ הַכֹּהֵן שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a lesion of leprosy.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי אִם־פָּשֹׂה תִפְשֶׂה בָּעוֹר וְטִמֵּא הַכֹּהֵן אֹתוֹ נֶגַע צָרַעַת הִוא׃

verses.english: But if the bright spot stays in its place, has not spread in the skin, and has faded, it is a swelling from the burn. The priest shall declare him clean, for it is the scar of the burn.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־תַּחְתֶּיהָ תַעֲמֹד הַבַּהֶרֶת לֹא־פָשְׂתָה בָעוֹר וְהִוא כֵהָה שְׂאֵת הַמִּכְוָה הִוא וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן כִּי־צָרֶבֶת הַמִּכְוָה הִוא׃

verses.english: If a man or woman has a lesion on the head or beard,
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁה כִּי־יִהְיֶה בוֹ נָגַע בְּרֹאשׁ אוֹ בְזָקָן׃

verses.english: the priest shall examine the lesion. If it appears deeper than the skin and has thin yellow hair in it, the priest shall declare him unclean. It is a scaly lesion, leprosy of the head or beard.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַנֶּגַע וְהִנֵּה מַרְאֵהוּ עָמֹק מִן־הָעוֹר וּבוֹ שֵׂעָר צָהֹב דָּק וְטִמֵּא אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן נֶתֶק הוּא צָרַעַת הָרֹאשׁ אוֹ הַזָּקָן הוּא׃

verses.english: If the priest examines the scaly lesion and it does not appear deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, the priest shall isolate the person with the scaly lesion for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־יִרְאֶה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־נֶגַע הַנֶּתֶק וְהִנֵּה אֵין־מַרְאֵהוּ עָמֹק מִן־הָעוֹר וְשֵׂעָר שָׁחֹר אֵין בּוֹ וְהִסְגִּיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־נֶגַע הַנֶּתֶק שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: The priest shall examine the lesion on the seventh day. If the scaly lesion has not spread, no yellow hair has appeared in it, and it does not appear deeper than the skin,
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַנֶּגַע בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְהִנֵּה לֹא־פָשָׂה הַנֶּתֶק וְלֹא־הָיָה בוֹ שֵׂעָר צָהֹב וּמַרְאֵה הַנֶּתֶק אֵין עָמֹק מִן־הָעוֹר׃

verses.english: he shall shave himself, but shall not shave the scaly lesion. The priest shall isolate the person with the scaly lesion for another seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְגַּלָּח וְאֶת־הַנֶּתֶק לֹא יְגַלֵּחַ וְהִסְגִּיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַנֶּתֶק שִׁבְעַת יָמִים שֵׁנִית׃

verses.english: The priest shall examine the scaly lesion on the seventh day. If it has not spread in the skin and does not appear deeper than the skin, the priest shall declare him clean. He shall wash his garments and be clean.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַנֶּתֶק בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְהִנֵּה לֹא־פָשָׂה הַנֶּתֶק בָּעוֹר וּמַרְאֵהוּ אֵינֶנּוּ עָמֹק מִן־הָעוֹר וְטִהַר אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְטָהֵר׃

verses.english: But if the scaly lesion spreads in the skin after his cleansing,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־פָּשֹׂה יִפְשֶׂה הַנֶּתֶק בָּעוֹר אַחֲרֵי טָהֳרָתוֹ׃

verses.english: the priest shall examine him. If the scaly lesion has spread in the skin, the priest need not look for yellow hair; he is unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָהוּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּתֶק בָּעוֹר לֹא־יְבַקֵּר הַכֹּהֵן לַשֵּׂעָר הַצָּהֹב טָמֵא הוּא׃

verses.english: But if in his eyes the scaly lesion has remained unchanged and black hair has grown in it, the scaly lesion has healed. He is clean, and the priest shall declare him clean.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בְּעֵינָיו עָמַד הַנֶּתֶק וְשֵׂעָר שָׁחֹר צָמַח־בּוֹ נִרְפָּא הַנֶּתֶק טָהוֹר הוּא וְטִהֲרוֹ הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: If a man or woman has bright spots on the skin of the body, white bright spots,
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אוֹ־אִשָּׁה כִּי־יִהְיֶה בְעוֹר־בְּשָׂרָם בֶּהָרֹת בֶּהָרֹת לְבָנֹת׃

verses.english: the priest shall examine them. If the bright spots on the skin of the body are dull white, it is a pale eruption that has broken out in the skin; he is clean.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה בְעוֹר־בְּשָׂרָם בֶּהָרֹת כֵּהוֹת לְבָנֹת בֹּהַק הוּא פָּרַח בָּעוֹר טָהוֹר הוּא׃

verses.english: If a man loses the hair of his head, he is bald; he is clean.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יִמָּרֵט רֹאשׁוֹ קֵרֵחַ הוּא טָהוֹר הוּא׃

verses.english: If he loses the hair at the front of his head, he is bald at the forehead; he is clean.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִפְּאַת פָּנָיו יִמָּרֵט רֹאשׁוֹ גִּבֵּחַ הוּא טָהוֹר הוּא׃

verses.english: But if there is a reddish-white lesion on his bald head or bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out on his bald head or bald forehead.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־יִהְיֶה בַקָּרַחַת אוֹ בַגַּבַּחַת נֶגַע לָבָן אֲדַמְדָּם צָרַעַת פֹּרַחַת הִוא בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: The priest shall examine him. If the swelling of the lesion on his bald head or bald forehead is reddish-white, like leprosy on the skin of the body,
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה שְׂאֵת־הַנֶּגַע לְבָנָה אֲדַמְדֶּמֶת בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּוֹ כְּמַרְאֵה צָרַעַת עוֹר בָּשָׂר׃

verses.english: he is a man with leprosy; he is unclean. The priest must declare him unclean; his lesion is on his head.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־צָרוּעַ הוּא טָמֵא הוּא טַמֵּא יְטַמְּאֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן בְּרֹאשׁוֹ נִגְעוֹ׃

verses.english: The person with leprosy who has the lesion shall wear torn garments, let his hair hang loose, cover his upper lip, and cry, Unclean! Unclean!
verses.hebrew: וְהַצָּרוּעַ אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ הַנֶּגַע בְּגָדָיו יִהְיוּ פְרֻמִים וְרֹאשׁוֹ יִהְיֶה פָרוּעַ וְעַל־שָׂפָם יַעְטֶה וְטָמֵא טָמֵא יִקְרָא׃

verses.english: He shall be unclean as long as the lesion is on him; he is unclean. He shall live alone; his dwelling shall be outside the camp.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־יְמֵי אֲשֶׁר הַנֶּגַע בּוֹ יִטְמָא טָמֵא הוּא בָּדָד יֵשֵׁב מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה מוֹשָׁבוֹ׃

verses.english: If a garment has a lesion of leprosy, whether a woolen garment or a linen garment,
verses.hebrew: וְהַבֶּגֶד כִּי־יִהְיֶה בוֹ נֶגַע צָרָעַת בְּבֶגֶד צֶמֶר אוֹ בְּבֶגֶד פִּשְׁתִּים׃

verses.english: or in the warp or weft of linen or wool, or in leather or anything made of leather,
verses.hebrew: אוֹ בִשְׁתִי אוֹ בְעֵרֶב לַפִּשְׁתִּים וְלַצָּמֶר אוֹ בְעוֹר אוֹ בְּכָל־מְלֶאכֶת עוֹר׃

verses.english: and the lesion in the garment, leather, warp, weft, or any leather article is greenish or reddish, it is a lesion of leprosy and shall be shown to the priest.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַנֶּגַע יְרַקְרַק אוֹ אֲדַמְדָּם בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ בָעוֹר אוֹ־בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ־בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בְכָל־כְּלִי־עוֹר נֶגַע צָרַעַת הוּא וְהָרְאָה אֶת־הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: The priest shall examine the lesion and isolate the affected article for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַנָּגַע וְהִסְגִּיר אֶת־הַנֶּגַע שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: On the seventh day he shall examine the lesion. If it has spread in the garment, warp, weft, or leather, whatever work the leather is used for, the lesion is malignant leprosy; it is unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה אֶת־הַנֶּגַע בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי כִּי־פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ־בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ־בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בָעוֹר לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֵעָשֶׂה הָעוֹר לִמְלָאכָה צָרַעַת מַמְאֶרֶת הַנֶּגַע טָמֵא הוּא׃

verses.english: He shall burn the garment, the warp or weft of wool or linen, or any leather article that has the lesion, for it is malignant leprosy; it shall be burned with fire.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׂרַף אֶת־הַבֶּגֶד אוֹ אֶת־הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ אֶת־הָעֵרֶב בַּצֶּמֶר אוֹ בַפִּשְׁתִּים אוֹ אֶת־כָּל־כְּלִי הָעוֹר אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה בוֹ הַנָּגַע כִּי־צָרַעַת מַמְאֶרֶת הִוא בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

verses.english: But if the priest examines it and the lesion has not spread in the garment, warp, weft, or any leather article,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם יִרְאֶה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה לֹא־פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בְּכָל־כְּלִי־עוֹר׃

verses.english: the priest shall give instructions, and they shall wash the article with the lesion; he shall isolate it for another seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְכִבְּסוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ הַנָּגַע וְהִסְגִּירוֹ שִׁבְעַת־יָמִים שֵׁנִית׃

verses.english: After it has been washed, the priest shall examine the lesion. If it has not changed its appearance, though it has not spread, it is unclean. Burn it with fire; it is a corrosive condition on its bare side or its hairy side.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן אַחֲרֵי הֻכַּבֵּס אֶת־הַנֶּגַע וְהִנֵּה לֹא־הָפַךְ הַנֶּגַע אֶת־עֵינוֹ וְהַנֶּגַע לֹא־פָשָׂה טָמֵא הוּא בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶנּוּ פְּחֶתֶת הִוא בְּקָרַחְתּוֹ אוֹ בְגַבַּחְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: But if the priest examines it and the lesion has faded after washing, he shall tear it out of the garment, leather, warp, or weft.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם רָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה כֵּהָה הַנֶּגַע אַחֲרֵי הֻכַּבֵּס אֹתוֹ וְקָרַע אֹתוֹ מִן־הַבֶּגֶד אוֹ מִן־הָעוֹר אוֹ מִן־הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ מִן־הָעֵרֶב׃

verses.english: If it appears again in the garment, warp, weft, or any leather article, it is breaking out; burn the affected article with fire.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־תֵּרָאֶה עוֹד בַּבֶּגֶד אוֹ־בַשְּׁתִי אוֹ־בָעֵרֶב אוֹ בְכָל־כְּלִי־עוֹר פֹּרַחַת הִוא בָּאֵשׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶנּוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ הַנָּגַע׃

verses.english: A garment, warp, weft, or any leather article that you wash, from which the lesion has departed, shall be washed a second time and be clean.
verses.hebrew: וְהַבֶּגֶד אוֹ־הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ־הָעֵרֶב אוֹ־כָל־כְּלִי הָעוֹר אֲשֶׁר תְּכַבֵּס וְסָר מֵהֶם הַנָּגַע וְכֻבַּס שֵׁנִית וְטָהֵר׃

verses.english: This is the law of a lesion of leprosy in a woolen or linen garment, warp, weft, or any leather article, for declaring it clean or unclean.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת נֶגַע־צָרַעַת בֶּגֶד הַצֶּמֶר אוֹ הַפִּשְׁתִּים אוֹ הַשְּׁתִי אוֹ הָעֵרֶב אוֹ כָּל־כְּלִי־עוֹר לְטַהֲרוֹ אוֹ לְטַמְּאוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: This shall be the law of the person with leprosy on the day of his cleansing: he shall be brought to the priest.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת תִּהְיֶה תּוֹרַת הַמְּצֹרָע בְּיוֹם טָהֳרָתוֹ וְהוּבָא אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: The priest shall go outside the camp and examine him. If the lesion of leprosy has healed in the person with leprosy,
verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַכֹּהֵן אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְרָאָה הַכֹּהֵן וְהִנֵּה נִרְפָּא נֶגַע־הַצָּרַעַת מִן־הַצָּרוּעַ׃

verses.english: the priest shall command that two living clean birds, cedarwood, scarlet material, and hyssop be taken for the person being cleansed.
verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְלָקַח לַמִּטַּהֵר שְׁתֵּי־צִפֳּרִים חַיּוֹת טְהֹרוֹת וְעֵץ אֶרֶז וּשְׁנִי תוֹלַעַת וְאֵזֹב׃

verses.english: The priest shall command that one bird be slaughtered over an earthenware vessel containing living water.
verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְשָׁחַט אֶת־הַצִּפּוֹר הָאֶחָת אֶל־כְּלִי־חֶרֶשׂ עַל־מַיִם חַיִּים׃

verses.english: He shall take the living bird, cedarwood, scarlet material, and hyssop, and dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird slaughtered over the living water.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה יִקַּח אֹתָהּ וְאֶת־עֵץ הָאֶרֶז וְאֶת־שְׁנִי הַתּוֹלַעַת וְאֶת־הָאֵזֹב וְטָבַל אוֹתָם וְאֵת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה בְּדַם הַצִּפֹּר הַשְּׁחֻטָה עַל הַמַּיִם הַחַיִּים׃

verses.english: He shall sprinkle the person being cleansed from leprosy seven times, declare him clean, and release the living bird into the open field.
verses.hebrew: וְהִזָּה עַל הַמִּטַּהֵר מִן־הַצָּרַעַת שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְטִהֲרוֹ וְשִׁלַּח אֶת־הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה׃

verses.english: The person being cleansed shall wash his garments, shave off all his hair, bathe in water, and be clean. Afterward he may enter the camp, but he shall remain outside his tent for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְכִבֶּס הַמִּטַּהֵר אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וְגִלַּח אֶת־כָּל־שְׂעָרוֹ וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָהֵר וְאַחַר יָבוֹא אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וְיָשַׁב מִחוּץ לְאָהֳלוֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: On the seventh day he shall shave off all his hair: his head, his beard, and his eyebrows; he shall shave off all his hair. He shall wash his garments, bathe his body in water, and be clean.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יְגַלַּח אֶת־כָּל־שְׂעָרוֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ וְאֶת־זְקָנוֹ וְאֵת גַּבֹּת עֵינָיו וְאֶת־כָּל־שְׂעָרוֹ יְגַלֵּחַ וְכִבֶּס אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת־בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמַּיִם וְטָהֵר׃

verses.english: On the eighth day he shall take two unblemished male lambs, one unblemished year-old ewe lamb, three tenths of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and one log of oil.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִקַּח שְׁנֵי־כְבָשִׂים תְּמִימִים וְכַבְשָׂה אַחַת בַּת־שְׁנָתָהּ תְּמִימָה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְלֹג אֶחָד שָׁמֶן׃

verses.english: The priest who performs the cleansing shall present the person being cleansed and these things before YHWH at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱמִיד הַכֹּהֵן הַמְטַהֵר אֵת הָאִישׁ הַמִּטַּהֵר וְאֹתָם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: The priest shall take one male lamb and present it as a guilt offering, with the log of oil, and wave them as a wave offering before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד וְהִקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לְאָשָׁם וְאֶת־לֹג הַשָּׁמֶן וְהֵנִיף אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: He shall slaughter the lamb in the holy place where the sin offering and burnt offering are slaughtered. Like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest; it is most holy.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֶת־הַכֶּבֶשׂ בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט אֶת־הַחַטָּאת וְאֶת־הָעֹלָה בִּמְקוֹם הַקֹּדֶשׁ כִּי כַּחַטָּאת הָאָשָׁם הוּא לַכֹּהֵן קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים הוּא׃

verses.english: The priest shall take some of the guilt offering’s blood and put it on the right earlobe of the person being cleansed, his right thumb, and his right big toe.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הָאָשָׁם וְנָתַן הַכֹּהֵן עַל־תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל־בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל־בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃

verses.english: The priest shall take some of the log of oil and pour it into the priest’s left palm.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִלֹּג הַשָּׁמֶן וְיָצַק עַל־כַּף הַכֹּהֵן הַשְּׂמָאלִית׃

verses.english: The priest shall dip his right finger into the oil in his left palm and sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְטָבַל הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־אֶצְבָּעוֹ הַיְמָנִית מִן־הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל־כַּפּוֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִית וְהִזָּה מִן־הַשֶּׁמֶן בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: From the oil remaining in his palm, the priest shall put some on the right earlobe of the person being cleansed, his right thumb, and his right big toe, upon the blood of the guilt offering.
verses.hebrew: וּמִיֶּתֶר הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל־כַּפּוֹ יִתֵּן הַכֹּהֵן עַל־תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל־בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל־בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית עַל דַּם הָאָשָׁם׃

verses.english: The remaining oil in the priest’s palm he shall put on the head of the person being cleansed. The priest shall make atonement for him before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתָר בַּשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל־כַּף הַכֹּהֵן יִתֵּן עַל־רֹאשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵר וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The priest shall prepare the sin offering and make atonement for the person being cleansed from his uncleanness. Afterward he shall slaughter the burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עַל־הַמִּטַּהֵר מִטֻּמְאָתוֹ וְאַחַר יִשְׁחַט אֶת־הָעֹלָה׃

verses.english: The priest shall offer up the burnt offering and grain offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱלָה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הָעֹלָה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן וְטָהֵר׃

verses.english: If he is poor and cannot afford these things, he shall take one male lamb as a guilt offering for waving, to make atonement for him, one tenth of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and a log of oil,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־דַּל הוּא וְאֵין יָדוֹ מַשֶּׂגֶת וְלָקַח כֶּבֶשׂ אֶחָד אָשָׁם לִתְנוּפָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו וְעִשָּׂרוֹן סֹלֶת אֶחָד בָּלוּל בַּשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָה וְלֹג שָׁמֶן׃

verses.english: and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, whichever he can afford, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ וְהָיָה אֶחָד חַטָּאת וְהָאֶחָד עֹלָה׃

verses.english: On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא אֹתָם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי לְטָהֳרָתוֹ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן אֶל־פֶּתַח אֹהֶל־מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The priest shall take the lamb of the guilt offering and the log of oil, and wave them as a wave offering before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־כֶּבֶשׂ הָאָשָׁם וְאֶת־לֹג הַשָּׁמֶן וְהֵנִיף אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: He shall slaughter the lamb of the guilt offering. The priest shall take some of its blood and put it on the right earlobe of the person being cleansed, his right thumb, and his right big toe.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֶת־כֶּבֶשׂ הָאָשָׁם וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִדַּם הָאָשָׁם וְנָתַן עַל־תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן־הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל־בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל־בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃

verses.english: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the priest’s left palm.
verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַשֶּׁמֶן יִצֹק הַכֹּהֵן עַל־כַּף הַכֹּהֵן הַשְּׂמָאלִית׃

verses.english: With his right finger the priest shall sprinkle some of the oil in his left palm seven times before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהִזָּה הַכֹּהֵן בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ הַיְמָנִית מִן־הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל־כַּפּוֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִית שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The priest shall put some of the oil in his palm on the right earlobe of the person being cleansed, his right thumb, and his right big toe, on the place of the guilt offering’s blood.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן הַכֹּהֵן מִן־הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל־כַּפּוֹ עַל־תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר הַיְמָנִית וְעַל־בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל־בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית עַל־מְקוֹם דַּם הָאָשָׁם׃

verses.english: He shall put the remaining oil in the priest’s palm on the head of the person being cleansed, to make atonement for him before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנּוֹתָר מִן־הַשֶּׁמֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל־כַּף הַכֹּהֵן יִתֵּן עַל־רֹאשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵר לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: He shall prepare one of the turtledoves or young pigeons, whichever he can afford,
verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה אֶת־הָאֶחָד מִן־הַתֹּרִים אוֹ מִן־בְּנֵי הַיּוֹנָה מֵאֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ׃

verses.english: whichever he can afford, one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering, together with the grain offering. The priest shall make atonement before YHWH for the person being cleansed.
verses.hebrew: אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ אֶת־הָאֶחָד חַטָּאת וְאֶת־הָאֶחָד עֹלָה עַל־הַמִּנְחָה וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל הַמִּטַּהֵר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: This is the law for the person with a lesion of leprosy who cannot afford what is required for his cleansing.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ נֶגַע צָרָעַת אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ בְּטָהֳרָתוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: When you enter the land of Canaan, which I give you as a possession, and I put a lesion of leprosy in a house in the land you possess,
verses.hebrew: כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה וְנָתַתִּי נֶגַע צָרַעַת בְּבֵית אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם׃

verses.english: the owner of the house shall come and tell the priest, saying: Something like a lesion has appeared to me in the house.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ הַבַּיִת וְהִגִּיד לַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר כְּנֶגַע נִרְאָה לִי בַּבָּיִת׃

verses.english: The priest shall command that the house be emptied before he enters to examine the lesion, so that nothing in the house becomes unclean. Afterward the priest shall enter to examine the house.
verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וּפִנּוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַכֹּהֵן לִרְאוֹת אֶת־הַנֶּגַע וְלֹא יִטְמָא כָּל־אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּיִת וְאַחַר כֵּן יָבֹא הַכֹּהֵן לִרְאוֹת אֶת־הַבָּיִת׃

verses.english: He shall examine the lesion. If the lesion in the walls of the house consists of greenish or reddish depressions that appear lower than the wall,
verses.hebrew: וְרָאָה אֶת־הַנֶּגַע וְהִנֵּה הַנֶּגַע בְּקִירֹת הַבַּיִת שְׁקַעֲרוּרֹת יְרַקְרַקֹּת אוֹ אֲדַמְדַּמֹּת וּמַרְאֵיהֶן שָׁפָל מִן־הַקִּיר׃

verses.english: the priest shall leave the house, go to its entrance, and close the house for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַכֹּהֵן מִן־הַבַּיִת אֶל־פֶּתַח הַבָּיִת וְהִסְגִּיר אֶת־הַבַּיִת שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: On the seventh day the priest shall return and examine it. If the lesion has spread in the walls of the house,
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב הַכֹּהֵן בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְרָאָה וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בְּקִירֹת הַבָּיִת׃

verses.english: the priest shall command them to remove the stones that have the lesion and throw them outside the city into an unclean place.
verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְחִלְּצוּ אֶת־הָאֲבָנִים אֲשֶׁר בָּהֵן הַנָּגַע וְהִשְׁלִיכוּ אֶתְהֶן אֶל־מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל־מָקוֹם טָמֵא׃

verses.english: He shall have the inside of the house scraped all around, and they shall pour the scraped-off plaster outside the city into an unclean place.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַבַּיִת יַקְצִעַ מִבַּיִת סָבִיב וְשָׁפְכוּ אֶת־הֶעָפָר אֲשֶׁר הִקְצוּ אֶל־מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל־מָקוֹם טָמֵא׃

verses.english: They shall take other stones and put them in place of those stones. He shall take other plaster and replaster the house.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקְחוּ אֲבָנִים אֲחֵרוֹת וְהֵבִיאוּ אֶל־תַּחַת הָאֲבָנִים וְעָפָר אַחֵר יִקַּח וְטָח אֶת־הַבָּיִת׃

verses.english: If the lesion returns and breaks out in the house after the stones have been removed and the house scraped and replastered,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־יָשׁוּב הַנֶּגַע וּפָרַח בַּבַּיִת אַחַר חִלֵּץ אֶת־הָאֲבָנִים וְאַחֲרֵי הִקְצוֹת אֶת־הַבַּיִת וְאַחֲרֵי הִטּוֹחַ׃

verses.english: the priest shall come and examine it. If the lesion has spread in the house, it is malignant leprosy in the house; it is unclean.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאָה וְהִנֵּה פָּשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבָּיִת צָרַעַת מַמְאֶרֶת הִוא בַּבַּיִת טָמֵא הוּא׃

verses.english: He shall demolish the house—its stones, its timbers, and all its plaster—and carry them outside the city into an unclean place.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַץ אֶת־הַבַּיִת אֶת־אֲבָנָיו וְאֶת־עֵצָיו וְאֵת כָּל־עֲפַר הַבָּיִת וְהוֹצִיא אֶל־מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל־מָקוֹם טָמֵא׃

verses.english: Whoever enters the house during any of the days it is closed shall be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְהַבָּא אֶל־הַבַּיִת כָּל־יְמֵי הִסְגִּיר אֹתוֹ יִטְמָא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Whoever lies down in the house shall wash his garments, and whoever eats in the house shall wash his garments.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשֹּׁכֵב בַּבַּיִת יְכַבֵּס אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וְהָאֹכֵל בַּבַּיִת יְכַבֵּס אֶת־בְּגָדָיו׃

verses.english: But if the priest comes and examines it, and the lesion has not spread in the house after it was replastered, the priest shall declare the house clean, for the lesion has healed.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בֹּא יָבֹא הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאָה וְהִנֵּה לֹא־פָשָׂה הַנֶּגַע בַּבַּיִת אַחֲרֵי הִטֹּחַ אֶת־הַבָּיִת וְטִהַר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַבַּיִת כִּי נִרְפָּא הַנָּגַע׃

verses.english: To purify the house he shall take two birds, cedarwood, scarlet material, and hyssop.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח לְחַטֵּא אֶת־הַבַּיִת שְׁתֵּי צִפֳּרִים וְעֵץ אֶרֶז וּשְׁנִי תוֹלַעַת וְאֵזֹב׃

verses.english: He shall slaughter one bird over an earthenware vessel containing living water.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֶת־הַצִּפֹּר הָאֶחָת אֶל־כְּלִי־חֶרֶשׂ עַל־מַיִם חַיִּים׃

verses.english: He shall take the cedarwood, hyssop, scarlet material, and living bird, dip them in the blood of the slaughtered bird and the living water, and sprinkle the house seven times.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֶת־עֵץ־הָאֶרֶז וְאֶת־הָאֵזֹב וְאֵת שְׁנִי הַתּוֹלַעַת וְאֵת הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה וְטָבַל אֹתָם בְּדַם הַצִּפֹּר הַשְּׁחוּטָה וּבַמַּיִם הַחַיִּים וְהִזָּה אֶל־הַבַּיִת שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃

verses.english: He shall purify the house with the bird’s blood, the living water, the living bird, the cedarwood, the hyssop, and the scarlet material.
verses.hebrew: וְחִטֵּא אֶת־הַבַּיִת בְּדַם הַצִּפּוֹר וּבַמַּיִם הַחַיִּים וּבַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה וּבְעֵץ הָאֶרֶז וּבָאֵזֹב וּבִשְׁנִי הַתּוֹלָעַת׃

verses.english: He shall release the living bird outside the city into the open field, make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.
verses.hebrew: וְשִׁלַּח אֶת־הַצִּפֹּר הַחַיָּה אֶל־מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וְכִפֶּר עַל־הַבַּיִת וְטָהֵר׃

verses.english: This is the law for every lesion of leprosy and every scaly lesion,
verses.hebrew: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה לְכָל־נֶגַע הַצָּרַעַת וְלַנָּתֶק׃

verses.english: for leprosy of a garment or house,
verses.hebrew: וּלְצָרַעַת הַבֶּגֶד וְלַבָּיִת׃

verses.english: for a swelling, a scab, or a bright spot,
verses.hebrew: וְלַשְׂאֵת וְלַסַּפַּחַת וְלַבֶּהָרֶת׃

verses.english: to teach when a thing is unclean and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.
verses.hebrew: לְהוֹרֹת בְּיוֹם הַטָּמֵא וּבְיוֹם הַטָּהֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַצָּרָעַת׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: If any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean.
verses.hebrew: דַּבְּרוּ אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲמַרְתֶּם אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי יִהְיֶה זָב מִבְּשָׂרוֹ זוֹבוֹ טָמֵא הוּא׃

verses.english: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body lets the discharge flow or his body is blocked by the discharge, it is his uncleanness.
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת תִּהְיֶה טֻמְאָתוֹ בְּזוֹבוֹ רָר בְּשָׂרוֹ אֶת־זוֹבוֹ אוֹ־הֶחְתִּים בְּשָׂרוֹ מִזּוֹבוֹ טֻמְאָתוֹ הִוא׃

verses.english: Every bed on which the man with the discharge lies shall be unclean, and every article on which he sits shall be unclean.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עָלָיו הַזָּב יִטְמָא וְכָל־הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֵׁב עָלָיו יִטְמָא׃

verses.english: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּמִשְׁכָּבוֹ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Whoever sits on an article on which the man with the discharge has sat shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְהַיֹּשֵׁב עַל־הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֵׁב עָלָיו הַזָּב יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Whoever touches the body of the man with the discharge shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בִּבְשַׂר הַזָּב יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: If the man with the discharge spits on someone clean, that person shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־יָרֹק הַזָּב בַּטָּהוֹר וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Any riding seat on which the man with the discharge rides shall be unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַמֶּרְכָּב אֲשֶׁר יִרְכַּב עָלָיו הַזָּב יִטְמָא׃

verses.english: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until evening. Whoever carries those things shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה תַחְתָּיו יִטְמָא עַד־הָעָרֶב וְהַנּוֹשֵׂא אוֹתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Anyone whom the man with the discharge touches without having rinsed his hands in water shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע־בּוֹ הַזָּב וְיָדָיו לֹא־שָׁטַף בַּמָּיִם וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: An earthenware vessel touched by the man with the discharge shall be broken, and every wooden vessel shall be rinsed with water.
verses.hebrew: וּכְלִי־חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּע־בּוֹ הַזָּב יִשָּׁבֵר וְכָל־כְּלִי־עֵץ יִשָּׁטֵף בַּמָּיִם׃

verses.english: When the man with the discharge is cleansed from his discharge, he shall count seven days for his cleansing, wash his garments, bathe his body in living water, and be clean.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־יִטְהַר הַזָּב מִזּוֹבוֹ וְסָפַר לוֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לְטָהֳרָתוֹ וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בְּמַיִם חַיִּים וְטָהֵר׃

verses.english: On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, come before YHWH to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יִקַּח־לוֹ שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה וּבָא לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֶל־פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּנְתָנָם אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: The priest shall prepare them, one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before YHWH for his discharge.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן אֶחָד חַטָּאת וְהָאֶחָד עֹלָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהוָה מִזּוֹבוֹ׃

verses.english: If a man has an emission of semen, he shall bathe his whole body in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי־תֵצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זָרַע וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם אֶת־כָּל־בְּשָׂרוֹ וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Every garment and every skin on which there is semen shall be washed with water and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־בֶּגֶד וְכָל־עוֹר אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה עָלָיו שִׁכְבַת־זָרַע וְכֻבַּס בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: If a man lies with a woman with an emission of semen, they shall bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אִישׁ אֹתָהּ שִׁכְבַת־זָרַע וְרָחֲצוּ בַמַּיִם וְטָמְאוּ עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: If a woman has a discharge, and the discharge from her body is blood, she shall remain in her menstrual separation for seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה כִּי־תִהְיֶה זָבָה דָּם יִהְיֶה זֹבָהּ בִּבְשָׂרָהּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תִּהְיֶה בְנִדָּתָהּ וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהּ יִטְמָא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Everything on which she lies during her menstrual separation shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁכַּב עָלָיו בְּנִדָּתָהּ יִטְמָא וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו יִטְמָא׃

verses.english: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Whoever touches any article on which she sits shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּכָל־כְּלִי אֲשֶׁר־תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Whether it is the bed or the article on which she sits, when he touches it he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּב הוּא אוֹ עַל־הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר־הִוא יֹשֶׁבֶת־עָלָיו בְּנָגְעוֹ־בוֹ יִטְמָא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: If a man lies with her and her menstrual impurity comes upon him, he shall be unclean for seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם שָׁכֹב יִשְׁכַּב אִישׁ אֹתָהּ וּתְהִי נִדָּתָהּ עָלָיו וְטָמֵא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְכָל־הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכַּב עָלָיו יִטְמָא׃

verses.english: If a woman has a discharge of blood for many days outside the time of her menstrual separation, or if it continues beyond her menstrual separation, all the days of her unclean discharge shall be like the days of her menstrual separation; she is unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה כִּי־יָזוּב זוֹב דָּמָהּ יָמִים רַבִּים בְּלֹא עֶת־נִדָּתָהּ אוֹ כִי־תָזוּב עַל־נִדָּתָהּ כָּל־יְמֵי זוֹב טֻמְאָתָהּ כִּימֵי נִדָּתָהּ תִּהְיֶה טְמֵאָה הִוא׃

verses.english: Every bed on which she lies during all the days of her discharge shall be like the bed of her menstrual separation, and every article on which she sits shall be unclean, as in her menstrual impurity.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּב אֲשֶׁר־תִּשְׁכַּב עָלָיו כָּל־יְמֵי זוֹבָהּ כְּמִשְׁכַּב נִדָּתָהּ יִהְיֶה־לָּהּ וְכָל־הַכְּלִי אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁב עָלָיו טָמֵא יִהְיֶה כְּטֻמְאַת נִדָּתָהּ׃

verses.english: Whoever touches them shall be unclean. He shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַנּוֹגֵעַ בָּם יִטְמָא וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: When she is cleansed from her discharge, she shall count seven days, and afterward she shall be clean.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־טָהֲרָה מִזּוֹבָהּ וְסָפְרָה לָּהּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְאַחַר תִּטְהָר׃

verses.english: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי תִּקַּח־לָהּ שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה וְהֵבִיאָה אוֹתָם אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן אֶל־פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: The priest shall prepare one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for her before YHWH for her unclean discharge.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הָאֶחָד חַטָּאת וְאֶת־הָאֶחָד עֹלָה וְכִפֶּר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהוָה מִזּוֹב טֻמְאָתָהּ׃

verses.english: You shall keep the sons of Israel separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die in their uncleanness by defiling My tabernacle that is among them.
verses.hebrew: וְהִזַּרְתֶּם אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִטֻּמְאָתָם וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ בְּטֻמְאָתָם בְּטַמְּאָם אֶת־מִשְׁכָּנִי אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכָם׃

verses.english: This is the law for the man with a discharge and for the one who has an emission of semen and becomes unclean through it,
verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַזָּב וַאֲשֶׁר תֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זֶרַע לְטָמְאָה־בָהּ׃

verses.english: for the woman in her menstrual separation, for anyone with a discharge, male or female, and for the man who lies with an unclean woman.
verses.hebrew: וְהַדָּוָה בְּנִדָּתָהּ וְהַזָּב אֶת־זוֹבוֹ לַזָּכָר וְלַנְּקֵבָה וּלְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב עִם־טְמֵאָה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron’s two sons, when they drew near before YHWH and died.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה אַחֲרֵי מוֹת שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן בְּקָרְבָתָם לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה וַיָּמֻתוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses: Speak to your brother Aaron, so that he does not enter at any time into the holy place inside the veil, before the atonement cover upon the ark, lest he die, for I will appear in the cloud over the atonement cover.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה דַּבֵּר אֶל־אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְאַל־יָבֹא בְכָל־עֵת אֶל־הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת אֶל־פְּנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל־הָאָרֹן וְלֹא יָמוּת כִּי בֶּעָנָן אֵרָאֶה עַל־הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

verses.english: With this Aaron shall enter the holy place: a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: בְּזֹאת יָבֹא אַהֲרֹן אֶל־הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּפַר בֶּן־בָּקָר לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל לְעֹלָה׃

verses.english: He shall put on a holy linen tunic, with linen undergarments over his body, gird himself with a linen sash, and wrap on a linen turban. These are holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water and put them on.
verses.hebrew: כְּתֹנֶת־בַּד קֹדֶשׁ יִלְבָּשׁ וּמִכְנְסֵי־בַד יִהְיוּ עַל־בְּשָׂרוֹ וּבְאַבְנֵט בַּד יַחְגֹּר וּבְמִצְנֶפֶת בַּד יִצְנֹף בִּגְדֵי־קֹדֶשׁ הֵם וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם אֶת־בְּשָׂרוֹ וּלְבֵשָׁם׃

verses.english: From the congregation of the sons of Israel he shall take two male goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: וּמֵאֵת עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יִקַּח שְׁנֵי־שְׂעִירֵי עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל אֶחָד לְעֹלָה׃

verses.english: Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering that is for himself and make atonement for himself and his household.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת־פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ׃

verses.english: He shall take the two goats and present them before YHWH at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֶת־שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִם וְהֶעֱמִיד אֹתָם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: Aaron shall cast lots over the two goats, one lot for YHWH and one lot for Azazel.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן אַהֲרֹן עַל־שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִם גּוֹרָלוֹת גּוֹרָל אֶחָד לַיהוָה וְגוֹרָל אֶחָד לַעֲזָאזֵל׃

verses.english: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot for YHWH fell and prepare it as a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת־הַשָּׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר עָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַיהוָה וְעָשָׂהוּ חַטָּאת׃

verses.english: The goat on which the lot for Azazel fell shall be presented alive before YHWH, to make atonement over it, to send it away to Azazel into the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשָּׂעִיר אֲשֶׁר עָלָה עָלָיו הַגּוֹרָל לַעֲזָאזֵל יָעֳמַד־חַי לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו לְשַׁלַּח אֹתוֹ לַעֲזָאזֵל הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

verses.english: Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering that is for himself and make atonement for himself and his household, and slaughter the bull of the sin offering that is for himself.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אַהֲרֹן אֶת־פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ וְשָׁחַט אֶת־פַּר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ׃

verses.english: He shall take a firepan full of burning coals from the altar before YHWH and two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense, and bring them inside the veil.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח מְלֹא־הַמַּחְתָּה גַּחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה וּמְלֹא חָפְנָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים דַּקָּה וְהֵבִיא מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת׃

verses.english: He shall put the incense on the fire before YHWH, so that the cloud of incense covers the atonement cover above the testimony, and he does not die.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן אֶת־הַקְּטֹרֶת עַל־הָאֵשׁ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְכִסָּה עֲנַן הַקְּטֹרֶת אֶת־הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל־הָעֵדוּת וְלֹא יָמוּת׃

verses.english: He shall take some of the bull’s blood and sprinkle it with his finger on the front of the atonement cover toward the east; before the atonement cover he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח מִדַּם הַפָּר וְהִזָּה בְאֶצְבָּעוֹ עַל־פְּנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת קֵדְמָה וְלִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת יַזֶּה שֶׁבַע־פְּעָמִים מִן־הַדָּם בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ׃

verses.english: He shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering for the people and bring its blood inside the veil. He shall do with its blood as he did with the bull’s blood, sprinkling it on the atonement cover and before the atonement cover.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁחַט אֶת־שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר לָעָם וְהֵבִיא אֶת־דָּמוֹ אֶל־מִבֵּית לַפָּרֹכֶת וְעָשָׂה אֶת־דָּמוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְדַם הַפָּר וְהִזָּה אֹתוֹ עַל־הַכַּפֹּרֶת וְלִפְנֵי הַכַּפֹּרֶת׃

verses.english: He shall make atonement for the holy place because of the sons of Israel’s uncleannesses and their transgressions, all their sins. He shall do the same for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them amid their uncleannesses.
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר עַל־הַקֹּדֶשׁ מִטֻּמְאֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִפִּשְׁעֵיהֶם לְכָל־חַטֹּאתָם וְכֵן יַעֲשֶׂה לְאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד הַשֹּׁכֵן אִתָּם בְּתוֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָם׃

verses.english: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the holy place until he comes out. He shall make atonement for himself, his household, and the whole assembly of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־אָדָם לֹא־יִהְיֶה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד בְּבֹאוֹ לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ עַד־צֵאתוֹ וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ וּבְעַד כָּל־קְהַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: He shall go out to the altar before YHWH and make atonement for it. He shall take some of the bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it all around on the altar’s horns.
verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו וְלָקַח מִדַּם הַפָּר וּמִדַּם הַשָּׂעִיר וְנָתַן עַל־קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃

verses.english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, cleanse it, and consecrate it from the sons of Israel’s uncleannesses.
verses.hebrew: וְהִזָּה עָלָיו מִן־הַדָּם בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְטִהֲרוֹ וְקִדְּשׁוֹ מִטֻּמְאֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: When he has finished making atonement for the holy place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the living goat.
verses.hebrew: וְכִלָּה מִכַּפֵּר אֶת־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהִקְרִיב אֶת־הַשָּׂעִיר הֶחָי׃

verses.english: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the living goat’s head and confess over it all the sons of Israel’s iniquities and all their transgressions, all their sins. He shall put them on the goat’s head and send it into the wilderness by the hand of a man appointed for the task.
verses.hebrew: וְסָמַךְ אַהֲרֹן אֶת־שְׁתֵּי ידו [יָדָיו] עַל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר הַחַי וְהִתְוַדָּה עָלָיו אֶת־כָּל־עֲוֺנֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־כָּל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם לְכָל־חַטֹּאתָם וְנָתַן אֹתָם עַל־רֹאשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר וְשִׁלַּח בְּיַד־אִישׁ עִתִּי הַמִּדְבָּרָה׃

verses.english: The goat shall bear upon itself all their iniquities to a remote land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וְנָשָׂא הַשָּׂעִיר עָלָיו אֶת־כָּל־עֲוֺנֹתָם אֶל־אֶרֶץ גְּזֵרָה וְשִׁלַּח אֶת־הַשָּׂעִיר בַּמִּדְבָּר׃

verses.english: Aaron shall enter the Tent of Meeting, take off the linen garments he wore when entering the holy place, and leave them there.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא אַהֲרֹן אֶל־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּפָשַׁט אֶת־בִּגְדֵי הַבָּד אֲשֶׁר לָבַשׁ בְּבֹאוֹ אֶל־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְהִנִּיחָם שָׁם׃

verses.english: He shall bathe his body in water in a holy place and put on his garments. He shall go out, prepare his burnt offering and the people’s burnt offering, and make atonement for himself and the people.
verses.hebrew: וְרָחַץ אֶת־בְּשָׂרוֹ בַמַּיִם בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ וְלָבַשׁ אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וְיָצָא וְעָשָׂה אֶת־עֹלָתוֹ וְאֶת־עֹלַת הָעָם וְכִפֶּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד הָעָם׃

verses.english: He shall burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת חֵלֶב הַחַטָּאת יַקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃

verses.english: The one who sends the goat away to Azazel shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water. Afterward he may enter the camp.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמְשַׁלֵּחַ אֶת־הַשָּׂעִיר לַעֲזָאזֵל יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת־בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן יָבוֹא אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

verses.english: He shall carry outside the camp the bull and goat of the sin offering whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place. They shall burn their hides, flesh, and dung with fire.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׂעִיר הַחַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר הוּבָא אֶת־דָּמָם לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ יוֹצִיא אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְשָׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ אֶת־עֹרֹתָם וְאֶת־בְּשָׂרָם וְאֶת־פִּרְשָׁם׃

verses.english: The one who burns them shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water. Afterward he may enter the camp.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשֹּׂרֵף אֹתָם יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ אֶת־בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן יָבוֹא אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

verses.english: This shall be a perpetual statute for you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, afflict yourselves and do no work, neither the native nor the resident foreigner living among you.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ תְּעַנּוּ אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם וְכָל־מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ הָאֶזְרָח וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

verses.english: For on this day he shall make atonement for you to cleanse you; from all your sins you shall be clean before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה תִּטְהָרוּ׃

verses.english: It is a Sabbath of complete rest for you, and you shall afflict yourselves; it is a perpetual statute.
verses.hebrew: שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן הִיא לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: The priest whom one anoints and whose hand one fills to serve as priest in his father’s place shall make atonement. He shall put on the linen garments, the holy garments,
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר־יִמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר יְמַלֵּא אֶת־יָדוֹ לְכַהֵן תַּחַת אָבִיו וְלָבַשׁ אֶת־בִּגְדֵי הַבָּד בִּגְדֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: and make atonement for the holy sanctuary, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar; he shall make atonement for the priests and all the people of the assembly.
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר אֶת־מִקְדַּשׁ הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ יְכַפֵּר וְעַל הַכֹּהֲנִים וְעַל־כָּל־עַם הַקָּהָל יְכַפֵּר׃

verses.english: This shall be a perpetual statute for you, to make atonement for the sons of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as YHWH commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה־זֹּאת לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְכַפֵּר עַל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכָּל־חַטֹּאתָם אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה וַיַּעַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to Aaron, his sons, and all the sons of Israel, and say to them: This is what YHWH commanded, saying:
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל־בָּנָיו וְאֶל כָּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Any man of the house of Israel who slaughters an ox, sheep, or goat in the camp, or slaughters it outside the camp,
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט שׁוֹר אוֹ־כֶשֶׂב אוֹ־עֵז בַּמַּחֲנֶה אוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַט מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

verses.english: and does not bring it to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting to present an offering to YHWH before YHWH’s tabernacle, bloodguilt shall be reckoned to that man. He has shed blood, and that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא הֱבִיאוֹ לְהַקְרִיב קָרְבָּן לַיהוָה לִפְנֵי מִשְׁכַּן יְהוָה דָּם יֵחָשֵׁב לָאִישׁ הַהוּא דָּם שָׁפָךְ וְנִכְרַת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ׃

verses.english: This is so that the sons of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they slaughter in the open field; they shall bring them to YHWH, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them as sacrifices of well-being to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר יָבִיאוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־זִבְחֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵם זֹבְחִים עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה וֶהֱבִיאֻם לַיהוָה אֶל־פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן וְזָבְחוּ זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים לַיהוָה אוֹתָם׃

verses.english: The priest shall dash the blood against YHWH’s altar at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat for a pleasing aroma to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְזָרַק הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַדָּם עַל־מִזְבַּח יְהוָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִקְטִיר הַחֵלֶב לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: They shall no longer sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat-demons after which they prostitute themselves. This shall be a perpetual statute for them throughout their generations.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יִזְבְּחוּ עוֹד אֶת־זִבְחֵיהֶם לַשְּׂעִירִם אֲשֶׁר הֵם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה־זֹּאת לָהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם׃

verses.english: Say to them: Any man of the house of Israel or of the resident foreigners living among them who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.hebrew: וַאֲלֵהֶם תֹּאמַר אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן־הַגֵּר אֲשֶׁר־יָגוּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲלֶה עֹלָה אוֹ־זָבַח׃

verses.english: and does not bring it to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting to offer it to YHWH, that man shall be cut off from his people.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לֹא יְבִיאֶנּוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֹתוֹ לַיהוָה וְנִכְרַת הָאִישׁ הַהוּא מֵעַמָּיו׃

verses.english: If any man of the house of Israel or of the resident foreigners living among them eats any blood, I will set My face against the person who eats the blood and cut him off from among his people.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן־הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יֹאכַל כָּל־דָּם וְנָתַתִּי פָנַי בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת אֶת־הַדָּם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתָהּ מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

verses.english: For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your lives, for the blood makes atonement by the life.
verses.hebrew: כִּי נֶפֶשׁ הַבָּשָׂר בַּדָּם הִוא וַאֲנִי נְתַתִּיו לָכֶם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לְכַפֵּר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כִּי־הַדָּם הוּא בַּנֶּפֶשׁ יְכַפֵּר׃

verses.english: Therefore I said to the sons of Israel: None of you shall eat blood, and the resident foreigner living among you shall not eat blood.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל־נֶפֶשׁ מִכֶּם לֹא־תֹאכַל דָּם וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם לֹא־יֹאכַל דָּם׃

verses.english: Any man of the sons of Israel or of the resident foreigners living among them who hunts an animal or bird that may be eaten shall pour out its blood and cover it with dust.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן־הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם אֲשֶׁר יָצוּד צֵיד חַיָּה אוֹ־עוֹף אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל וְשָׁפַךְ אֶת־דָּמוֹ וְכִסָּהוּ בֶּעָפָר׃

verses.english: For the life of all flesh is its blood with its life. I said to the sons of Israel: You shall not eat the blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־נֶפֶשׁ כָּל־בָּשָׂר דָּמוֹ בְנַפְשׁוֹ הוּא וָאֹמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דַּם כָּל־בָּשָׂר לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ כִּי נֶפֶשׁ כָּל־בָּשָׂר דָּמוֹ הִוא כָּל־אֹכְלָיו יִכָּרֵת׃

verses.english: Anyone, native or resident foreigner, who eats an animal found dead or torn by wild animals shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening; then he shall be clean.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה בָּאֶזְרָח וּבַגֵּר וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעֶרֶב וְטָהֵר׃

verses.english: But if he does not wash them and does not bathe his body, he shall bear his guilt.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא יְכַבֵּס וּבְשָׂרוֹ לֹא יִרְחָץ וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall not act according to the practices of the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not act according to the practices of the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not walk in their statutes.
verses.hebrew: כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֶרֶץ־מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁבְתֶּם־בָּהּ לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וּכְמַעֲשֵׂה אֶרֶץ־כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וּבְחֻקֹּתֵיהֶם לֹא תֵלֵכוּ׃

verses.english: You shall carry out My judgments and keep My statutes, walking in them. I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי תַּעֲשׂוּ וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לָלֶכֶת בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall keep My statutes and My judgments; the person who does them shall live by them. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָם הָאָדָם וָחַי בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: None of you shall approach any close relative of his flesh to uncover nakedness. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִישׁ אֶל־כָּל־שְׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ לֹא תִקְרְבוּ לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָה אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover your father’s nakedness or your mother’s nakedness. She is your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אָבִיךָ וְעֶרְוַת אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אִמְּךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife; it is your father’s nakedness.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֵשֶׁת־אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה עֶרְוַת אָבִיךָ הִוא׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether born at home or born outside.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹתְךָ בַת־אָבִיךָ אוֹ בַת־אִמֶּךָ מוֹלֶדֶת בַּיִת אוֹ מוֹלֶדֶת חוּץ לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָן׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, for theirs is your nakedness.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת בַּת־בִּנְךָ אוֹ בַת־בִּתְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָן כִּי עֶרְוָתְךָ הֵנָּה׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, begotten by your father; she is your sister.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת בַּת־אֵשֶׁת אָבִיךָ מוֹלֶדֶת אָבִיךָ אֲחוֹתְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת־אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה שְׁאֵר אָבִיךָ הִוא׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister; she is your mother’s close relative.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת־אִמְּךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּי־שְׁאֵר אִמְּךָ הִוא׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother; you shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֲחִי־אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ לֹא תִקְרָב דֹּדָתְךָ הִוא׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover your daughter-in-law’s nakedness. She is your son’s wife; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת כַּלָּתְךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֵשֶׁת בִּנְךָ הִוא לֹא תְגַלֶּה עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife; it is your brother’s nakedness.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אֵשֶׁת־אָחִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה עֶרְוַת אָחִיךָ הִוא׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter to uncover her nakedness; they are close relatives. It is a wicked scheme.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְוַת אִשָּׁה וּבִתָּהּ לֹא תְגַלֵּה אֶת־בַּת־בְּנָהּ וְאֶת־בַּת־בִּתָּהּ לֹא תִקַּח לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ שַׁאֲרָה הֵנָּה זִמָּה הִוא

verses.english: You shall not take a woman in addition to her sister as a rival, to uncover her nakedness alongside her while she is alive.
verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה אֶל־אֲחֹתָהּ לֹא תִקָּח לִצְרֹר לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ עָלֶיהָ בְּחַיֶּיהָ׃

verses.english: You shall not approach a woman in her menstrual uncleanness to uncover her nakedness.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־אִשָּׁה בְּנִדַּת טֻמְאָתָהּ לֹא תִקְרַב לְגַלּוֹת עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

verses.english: You shall not lie with your neighbor’s wife to emit semen and become defiled through her.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־אֵשֶׁת עֲמִיתְךָ לֹא־תִתֵּן שְׁכָבְתְּךָ לְזָרַע לְטָמְאָה־בָהּ׃

verses.english: You shall not give any of your offspring to be passed over to Molech, and you shall not profane the name of your God. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּמִזַּרְעֲךָ לֹא־תִתֵּן לְהַעֲבִיר לַמֹּלֶךְ וְלֹא תְחַלֵּל אֶת־שֵׁם אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: You shall not lie with a male as one lies with a woman; it is an abomination.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־זָכָר לֹא תִשְׁכַּב מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִשָּׁה תּוֹעֵבָה הִוא׃

verses.english: You shall not lie with any animal and become defiled through it. A woman shall not stand before an animal to mate with it; it is a perversion.
verses.hebrew: וּבְכָל־בְּהֵמָה לֹא־תִתֵּן שְׁכָבְתְּךָ לְטָמְאָה־בָהּ וְאִשָּׁה לֹא־תַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי בְהֵמָה לְרִבְעָהּ תֶּבֶל הוּא׃

verses.english: Do not defile yourselves by any of these things, for by all these things the nations I am driving out before you became defiled.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּטַּמְּאוּ בְּכָל־אֵלֶּה כִּי בְכָל־אֵלֶּה נִטְמְאוּ הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי מְשַׁלֵּחַ מִפְּנֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: The land became defiled, and I visited its iniquity upon it, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּטְמָא הָאָרֶץ וָאֶפְקֹד עֲוֺנָהּ עָלֶיהָ וַתָּקִא הָאָרֶץ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֶיהָ׃

verses.english: But you shall keep My statutes and My judgments and do none of these abominations, neither the native nor the resident foreigner living among you.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אַתֶּם אֶת־חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ מִכֹּל הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵלֶּה הָאֶזְרָח וְהַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

verses.english: For the people of the land who were before you did all these abominations, and the land became defiled.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת־כָּל־הַתּוֹעֵבֹת הָאֵל עָשׂוּ אַנְשֵׁי־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵיכֶם וַתִּטְמָא הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: so that the land does not vomit you out when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation before you.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תָקִיא הָאָרֶץ אֶתְכֶם בְּטַמַּאֲכֶם אֹתָהּ כַּאֲשֶׁר קָאָה אֶת־הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: For whoever does any of these abominations, the persons who do them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כָּל־אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה מִכֹּל הַתּוֹעֵבוֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְנִכְרְתוּ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת הָעֹשֹׂת מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

verses.english: Keep My charge, so that you do none of the abominable practices done before you, and do not defile yourselves by them. I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּי לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת מֵחֻקּוֹת הַתּוֹעֵבֹת אֲשֶׁר נַעֲשׂוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם וְלֹא תִטַּמְּאוּ בָּהֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר

verses.english: Speak to the whole congregation of the sons of Israel and say to them: You shall be holy, for I, YHWH your God, am holy.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם קְדֹשִׁים תִּהְיוּ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Each of you shall revere his mother and his father, and you shall keep My Sabbaths. I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִמּוֹ וְאָבִיו תִּירָאוּ וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Do not turn to idols or make molten gods for yourselves. I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּפְנוּ אֶל־הָאֱלִילִים וֵאלֹהֵי מַסֵּכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: When you sacrifice a sacrifice of well-being to YHWH, sacrifice it for your acceptance.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תִזְבְּחוּ זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּחֻהוּ׃

verses.english: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it and on the next day. What remains until the third day shall be burned with fire.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם זִבְחֲכֶם יֵאָכֵל וּמִמָּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר עַד־יוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף׃

verses.english: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is offensive; it shall not be accepted.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי פִּגּוּל הוּא לֹא יֵרָצֶה׃

verses.english: Whoever eats it shall bear his guilt, for he has profaned YHWH’s holy thing, and that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.hebrew: וְאֹכְלָיו עֲוֺנוֹ יִשָּׂא כִּי־אֶת־קֹדֶשׁ יְהוָה חִלֵּל וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

verses.english: When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap your field to its very edge or gather the gleanings of your harvest.
verses.hebrew: וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת־קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ לִקְצֹר וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט׃

verses.english: Do not strip your vineyard or gather its fallen grapes; leave them for the poor and the resident foreigner. I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל וּפֶרֶט כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall not steal, deal falsely, or lie to one another.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תִּגְנֹבוּ וְלֹא־תְכַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹא־תְשַׁקְּרוּ אִישׁ בַּעֲמִיתוֹ׃

verses.english: You shall not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תִשָּׁבְעוּ בִשְׁמִי לַשָּׁקֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ אֶת־שֵׁם אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: You shall not oppress your neighbor or rob him. A hired worker’s wages shall not remain with you overnight until morning.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תַעֲשֹׁק אֶת־רֵעֲךָ וְלֹא תִגְזֹל לֹא־תָלִין פְּעֻלַּת שָׂכִיר אִתְּךָ עַד־בֹּקֶר׃

verses.english: You shall not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block before the blind. You shall fear your God. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תְקַלֵּל חֵרֵשׁ וְלִפְנֵי עִוֵּר לֹא תִתֵּן מִכְשֹׁל וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: You shall do no injustice in judgment. Do not favor the poor or defer to the great; judge your neighbor in righteousness.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט לֹא־תִשָּׂא פְנֵי־דָל וְלֹא תֶהְדַּר פְּנֵי גָדוֹל בְּצֶדֶק תִּשְׁפֹּט עֲמִיתֶךָ׃

verses.english: You shall not go about as a slanderer among your people. You shall not stand by at your neighbor’s blood. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תֵלֵךְ רָכִיל בְּעַמֶּיךָ לֹא תַעֲמֹד עַל־דַּם רֵעֶךָ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You must reprove your neighbor, and you shall not bear sin because of him.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תִשְׂנָא אֶת־אָחִיךָ בִּלְבָבֶךָ הוֹכֵחַ תּוֹכִיחַ אֶת־עֲמִיתֶךָ וְלֹא־תִשָּׂא עָלָיו חֵטְא׃

verses.english: You shall not take vengeance or hold a grudge against the sons of your people. You shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תִקֹּם וְלֹא־תִטֹּר אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: You shall keep My statutes. Do not mate your livestock with a different kind. Do not sow your field with mixed kinds. Do not put on a garment of mixed fabric, shaatnez.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־חֻקֹּתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ בְּהֶמְתְּךָ לֹא־תַרְבִּיעַ כִּלְאַיִם שָׂדְךָ לֹא־תִזְרַע כִּלְאָיִם וּבֶגֶד כִּלְאַיִם שַׁעַטְנֵז לֹא יַעֲלֶה עָלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: If a man lies with a woman with an emission of semen, and she is a slave woman designated for another man but has not been redeemed or given freedom, there shall be an inquiry. They shall not be put to death, because she has not been freed.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי־יִשְׁכַּב אֶת־אִשָּׁה שִׁכְבַת־זֶרַע וְהִוא שִׁפְחָה נֶחֱרֶפֶת לְאִישׁ וְהָפְדֵּה לֹא נִפְדָּתָה אוֹ חֻפְשָׁה לֹא נִתַּן־לָהּ בִּקֹּרֶת תִּהְיֶה לֹא יוּמְתוּ כִּי־לֹא חֻפָּשָׁה׃

verses.english: He shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, a ram for a guilt offering.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא אֶת־אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהוָה אֶל־פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֵיל אָשָׁם׃

verses.english: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering before YHWH for the sin he has committed, and he shall be forgiven for the sin he has committed.
verses.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן בְּאֵיל הָאָשָׁם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה עַל־חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא׃

verses.english: When you enter the land and plant any food tree, you shall regard its fruit as uncircumcised. For three years it shall be uncircumcised for you; it shall not be eaten.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־תָבֹאוּ אֶל־הָאָרֶץ וּנְטַעְתֶּם כָּל־עֵץ מַאֲכָל וַעֲרַלְתֶּם עָרְלָתוֹ אֶת־פִּרְיוֹ שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים יִהְיֶה לָכֶם עֲרֵלִים לֹא יֵאָכֵל׃

verses.english: In the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, an offering of praise to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הָרְבִיעִת יִהְיֶה כָּל־פִּרְיוֹ קֹדֶשׁ הִלּוּלִים לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: In the fifth year you may eat its fruit, so that its yield may increase for you. I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַחֲמִישִׁת תֹּאכְלוּ אֶת־פִּרְיוֹ לְהוֹסִיף לָכֶם תְּבוּאָתוֹ אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall not eat over the blood. You shall not practice divination or interpret omens.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תֹאכְלוּ עַל־הַדָּם לֹא תְנַחֲשׁוּ וְלֹא תְעוֹנֵנוּ׃

verses.english: You shall not round off the edges of your heads or destroy the edges of your beard.
verses.hebrew: לֹא תַקִּפוּ פְּאַת רֹאשְׁכֶם וְלֹא תַשְׁחִית אֵת פְּאַת זְקָנֶךָ׃

verses.english: You shall not make cuts in your flesh for the dead or put tattooed markings on yourselves. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְשֶׂרֶט לָנֶפֶשׁ לֹא תִתְּנוּ בִּבְשַׂרְכֶם וּכְתֹבֶת קַעֲקַע לֹא תִתְּנוּ בָּכֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Do not profane your daughter by making her a prostitute, so that the land does not prostitute itself and become full of wickedness.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּחַלֵּל אֶת־בִּתְּךָ לְהַזְנוֹתָהּ וְלֹא־תִזְנֶה הָאָרֶץ וּמָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ זִמָּה׃

verses.english: You shall keep My Sabbaths and revere My sanctuary. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Do not turn to mediums or spirit-knowers; do not seek them and become defiled by them. I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּפְנוּ אֶל־הָאֹבֹת וְאֶל־הַיִּדְּעֹנִים אַל־תְּבַקְשׁוּ לְטָמְאָה בָהֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall rise before gray hair, honor an elder, and fear your God. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מִפְּנֵי שֵׂיבָה תָּקוּם וְהָדַרְתָּ פְּנֵי זָקֵן וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: When a resident foreigner lives with you in your land, you shall not mistreat him.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־יָגוּר אִתְּךָ גֵּר בְּאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תוֹנוּ אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: The resident foreigner living with you shall be like a native among you. You shall love him as yourself, for you were resident foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: כְּאֶזְרָח מִכֶּם יִהְיֶה לָכֶם הַגֵּר הַגָּר אִתְּכֶם וְאָהַבְתָּ לוֹ כָּמוֹךָ כִּי־גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall do no injustice in judgment, in length, weight, or volume.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תַעֲשׂוּ עָוֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּט בַּמִּדָּה בַּמִּשְׁקָל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָה׃

verses.english: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am YHWH your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: מֹאזְנֵי צֶדֶק אַבְנֵי־צֶדֶק אֵיפַת צֶדֶק וְהִין צֶדֶק יִהְיֶה לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: You shall keep all My statutes and all My judgments and do them. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־כָּל־חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: You shall say to the sons of Israel: Any man of the sons of Israel, or of the resident foreigners residing in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תֹּאמַר אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן־הַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִזַּרְעוֹ לַמֹּלֶךְ מוֹת יוּמָת עַם הָאָרֶץ יִרְגְּמֻהוּ בָאָבֶן׃
