verses.english: I Myself will set My face against that man and cut him off from among his people, because he gave some of his offspring to Molech, defiling My sanctuary and profaning My holy name.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אֶתֵּן אֶת־פָּנַי בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ כִּי מִזַּרְעוֹ נָתַן לַמֹּלֶךְ לְמַעַן טַמֵּא אֶת־מִקְדָּשִׁי וּלְחַלֵּל אֶת־שֵׁם קָדְשִׁי׃

verses.english: If the people of the land deliberately close their eyes to that man when he gives some of his offspring to Molech, and do not put him to death,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם הַעְלֵם יַעְלִימוּ עַם הָאָרֶץ אֶת־עֵינֵיהֶם מִן־הָאִישׁ הַהוּא בְּתִתּוֹ מִזַּרְעוֹ לַמֹּלֶךְ לְבִלְתִּי הָמִית אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: then I will set My face against that man and his family. I will cut him off from among their people, together with all who prostitute themselves after him by prostituting themselves after Molech.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי אֲנִי אֶת־פָּנַי בָּאִישׁ הַהוּא וּבְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֵת כָּל־הַזֹּנִים אַחֲרָיו לִזְנוֹת אַחֲרֵי הַמֹּלֶךְ מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

verses.english: As for the person who turns to mediums and spirit-knowers, prostituting himself after them, I will set My face against that person and cut him off from among his people.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּפְנֶה אֶל־הָאֹבֹת וְאֶל־הַיִּדְּעֹנִים לִזְנוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־פָּנַי בַּנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא וְהִכְרַתִּי אֹתוֹ מִקֶּרֶב עַמּוֹ׃

verses.english: Consecrate yourselves and be holy, for I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Keep My statutes and do them. I am YHWH who sanctifies you.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־חֻקֹּתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

verses.english: Any man who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother; his blood is upon him.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אִישׁ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יְקַלֵּל אֶת־אָבִיו וְאֶת־אִמּוֹ מוֹת יוּמָת אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ קִלֵּל דָּמָיו בּוֹ׃

verses.english: If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife, committing adultery with his neighbor’s wife, both the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִנְאַף אֶת־אֵשֶׁת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִנְאַף אֶת־אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ מוֹת־יוּמַת הַנֹּאֵף וְהַנֹּאָפֶת׃

verses.english: If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both shall surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת־אֵשֶׁת אָבִיו עֶרְוַת אָבִיו גִּלָּה מוֹת־יוּמְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

verses.english: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion; their blood is upon them.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת־כַּלָּתוֹ מוֹת יוּמְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם תֶּבֶל עָשׂוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

verses.english: If a man lies with a male as one lies with a woman, both have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת־זָכָר מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִשָּׁה תּוֹעֵבָה עָשׂוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מוֹת יוּמָתוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

verses.english: If a man takes a woman and her mother, it is a wicked scheme. They shall burn him and them with fire, so that there may be no wickedness among you.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת־אִשָּׁה וְאֶת־אִמָּהּ זִמָּה הִוא בָּאֵשׁ יִשְׂרְפוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶתְהֶן וְלֹא־תִהְיֶה זִמָּה בְּתוֹכְכֶם׃

verses.english: If a man has intercourse with an animal, he shall surely be put to death, and you shall kill the animal.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן שְׁכָבְתּוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָת וְאֶת־הַבְּהֵמָה תַּהֲרֹגוּ׃

verses.english: If a woman approaches any animal to mate with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרַב אֶל־כָּל־בְּהֵמָה לְרִבְעָה אֹתָהּ וְהָרַגְתָּ אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה וְאֶת־הַבְּהֵמָה מוֹת יוּמָתוּ דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

verses.english: If a man takes his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter, and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a disgrace. They shall be cut off before the eyes of the sons of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his guilt.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִקַּח אֶת־אֲחֹתוֹ בַּת־אָבִיו אוֹ בַת־אִמּוֹ וְרָאָה אֶת־עֶרְוָתָהּ וְהִיא־תִרְאֶה אֶת־עֶרְוָתוֹ חֶסֶד הוּא וְנִכְרְתוּ לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי עַמָּם עֶרְוַת אֲחֹתוֹ גִּלָּה עֲוֺנוֹ יִשָּׂא׃

verses.english: If a man lies with a woman during her menstrual illness and uncovers her nakedness, he has exposed her fountain, and she has uncovered the source of her blood. Both shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכַּב אֶת־אִשָּׁה דָּוָה וְגִלָּה אֶת־עֶרְוָתָהּ אֶת־מְקֹרָהּ הֶעֱרָה וְהִיא גִּלְּתָה אֶת־מְקוֹר דָּמֶיהָ וְנִכְרְתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּם׃

verses.english: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister or your father’s sister, for one who does so exposes his close kin. They shall bear their guilt.
verses.hebrew: וְעֶרְוַת אֲחוֹת אִמְּךָ וַאֲחוֹת אָבִיךָ לֹא תְגַלֵּה כִּי אֶת־שְׁאֵרוֹ הֶעֱרָה עֲוֺנָם יִשָּׂאוּ׃

verses.english: If a man lies with his aunt, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב אֶת־דֹּדָתוֹ עֶרְוַת דֹּדוֹ גִּלָּה חֶטְאָם יִשָּׂאוּ עֲרִירִים יָמֻתוּ׃

verses.english: If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּח אֶת־אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו נִדָּה הִוא עֶרְוַת אָחִיו גִּלָּה עֲרִירִים יִהְיוּ׃

verses.english: Keep all My statutes and all My judgments and do them, so that the land to which I am bringing you to dwell does not vomit you out.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם אֶת־כָּל־חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא־תָקִיא אֶתְכֶם הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה לָשֶׁבֶת בָּהּ׃

verses.english: You shall not walk in the statutes of the nation that I am driving out before you, for they did all these things, and I abhorred them.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תֵלְכוּ בְּחֻקֹּת הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי מְשַׁלֵּחַ מִפְּנֵיכֶם כִּי אֶת־כָּל־אֵלֶּה עָשׂוּ וָאָקֻץ בָּם׃

verses.english: I said to you: You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey. I am YHWH your God, who separated you from the peoples.
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר לָכֶם אַתֶּם תִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־אַדְמָתָם וַאֲנִי אֶתְּנֶנָּה לָכֶם לָרֶשֶׁת אֹתָהּ אֶרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־הִבְדַּלְתִּי אֶתְכֶם מִן־הָעַמִּים׃

verses.english: You shall distinguish between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean bird and the clean. Do not make yourselves detestable through animal or bird or anything that creeps on the ground, which I have set apart for you as unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְהִבְדַּלְתֶּם בֵּין־הַבְּהֵמָה הַטְּהֹרָה לַטְּמֵאָה וּבֵין־הָעוֹף הַטָּמֵא לַטָּהֹר וְלֹא־תְשַׁקְּצוּ אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בַּבְּהֵמָה וּבָעוֹף וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּרְמֹשׂ הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר־הִבְדַּלְתִּי לָכֶם לְטַמֵּא׃

verses.english: You shall be holy to Me, for I, YHWH, am holy. I separated you from the peoples to be Mine.
verses.hebrew: וִהְיִיתֶם לִי קְדֹשִׁים כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהוָה וָאַבְדִּל אֶתְכֶם מִן־הָעַמִּים לִהְיוֹת לִי׃

verses.english: A man or a woman in whom there is a medium or a spirit-knower shall surely be put to death. They shall stone them with stones; their blood is upon them.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אוֹ־אִשָּׁה כִּי־יִהְיֶה בָהֶם אוֹב אוֹ יִדְּעֹנִי מוֹת יוּמָתוּ בָּאֶבֶן יִרְגְּמוּ אֹתָם דְּמֵיהֶם בָּם׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses: Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: A priest shall not make himself unclean for a dead person among his people,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה אֱמֹר אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם לְנֶפֶשׁ לֹא־יִטַּמָּא בְּעַמָּיו׃

verses.english: except for his nearest kin: his mother, his father, his son, his daughter, and his brother;
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־לִשְׁאֵרוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו לְאִמּוֹ וּלְאָבִיו וְלִבְנוֹ וּלְבִתּוֹ וּלְאָחִיו׃

verses.english: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has not belonged to a man—for her he may make himself unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְלַאֲחֹתוֹ הַבְּתוּלָה הַקְּרוֹבָה אֵלָיו אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הָיְתָה לְאִישׁ לָהּ יִטַּמָּא׃

verses.english: He shall not make himself unclean as a husband among his people, profaning himself.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יִטַּמָּא בַּעַל בְּעַמָּיו לְהֵחַלּוֹ׃

verses.english: They shall not make a bald patch on their heads, shave the edge of their beards, or cut gashes in their flesh.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יקרחה [יִקְרְחוּ] קָרְחָה בְּרֹאשָׁם וּפְאַת זְקָנָם לֹא יְגַלֵּחוּ וּבִבְשָׂרָם לֹא יִשְׂרְטוּ שָׂרָטֶת׃

verses.english: They shall be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God, for they present YHWH’s offerings by fire, the bread of their God; therefore they shall be holy.
verses.hebrew: קְדֹשִׁים יִהְיוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי אֶת־אִשֵּׁי יְהוָה לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הֵם מַקְרִיבִם וְהָיוּ קֹדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: They shall not take a woman who is a prostitute or profaned, nor shall they take a woman divorced from her husband, for the priest is holy to his God.
verses.hebrew: אִשָּׁה זֹנָה וַחֲלָלָה לֹא יִקָּחוּ וְאִשָּׁה גְּרוּשָׁה מֵאִישָׁהּ לֹא יִקָּחוּ כִּי־קָדֹשׁ הוּא לֵאלֹהָיו׃

verses.english: You shall regard him as holy, for he presents the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I, YHWH who sanctifies you, am holy.
verses.hebrew: וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ כִּי־אֶת־לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא מַקְרִיב קָדֹשׁ יִהְיֶה־לָּךְ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

verses.english: If a priest’s daughter profanes herself by prostitution, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.
verses.hebrew: וּבַת אִישׁ כֹּהֵן כִּי תֵחֵל לִזְנוֹת אֶת־אָבִיהָ הִיא מְחַלֶּלֶת בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃

verses.english: The priest who is greatest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil has been poured and whose hand has been filled to wear the garments, shall not let his hair hang loose or tear his garments.
verses.hebrew: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדוֹל מֵאֶחָיו אֲ‍שֶׁר־יוּצַק עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וּמִלֵּא אֶת־יָדוֹ לִלְבֹּשׁ אֶת־הַבְּגָדִים אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ לֹא יִפְרָע וּבְגָדָיו לֹא יִפְרֹם׃

verses.english: He shall not enter where there is any dead person; he shall not make himself unclean even for his father or mother.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל כָּל־נַפְשֹׁת מֵת לֹא יָבֹא לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לֹא יִטַּמָּא׃

verses.english: He shall not leave the sanctuary or profane the sanctuary of his God, for the consecration of his God’s anointing oil is upon him. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא יֵצֵא וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל אֵת מִקְדַּשׁ אֱלֹהָיו כִּי נֵזֶר שֶׁמֶן מִשְׁחַת אֱלֹהָיו עָלָיו אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: He shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא אִשָּׁה בִבְתוּלֶיהָ יִקָּח׃

verses.english: A widow, a divorced woman, or a profaned woman who is a prostitute—these he shall not take. He shall take as his wife a virgin from his people.
verses.hebrew: אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה וַחֲלָלָה זֹנָה אֶת־אֵלֶּה לֹא יִקָּח כִּי אִם־בְּתוּלָה מֵעַמָּיו יִקַּח אִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am YHWH who sanctifies him.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יְחַלֵּל זַרְעוֹ בְּעַמָּיו כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה מְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to Aaron, saying: Any man among your offspring throughout their generations who has a blemish shall not approach to present the bread of his God.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר אִישׁ מִזַּרְעֲךָ לְדֹרֹתָם אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בוֹ מוּם לֹא יִקְרַב לְהַקְרִיב לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו׃

verses.english: No man who has a blemish shall approach: a blind man, a lame man, one with a mutilated nose, or one with an overgrown limb;
verses.hebrew: כִּי כָל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ מוּם לֹא יִקְרָב אִישׁ עִוֵּר אוֹ פִסֵּחַ אוֹ חָרֻם אוֹ שָׂרוּעַ׃

verses.english: or a man with a broken foot or a broken hand;
verses.hebrew: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה בוֹ שֶׁבֶר רָגֶל אוֹ שֶׁבֶר יָד׃

verses.english: or a hunchback, one who is wasted, one with a defect in his eye, one with a scab or skin eruption, or one with a crushed testicle.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ־גִבֵּן אוֹ־דַק אוֹ תְּבַלֻּל בְּעֵינוֹ אוֹ גָרָב אוֹ יַלֶּפֶת אוֹ מְרוֹחַ אָשֶׁךְ׃

verses.english: No man among the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a blemish shall approach to present YHWH’s offerings by fire. He has a blemish; he shall not approach to present the bread of his God.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ מוּם מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן לֹא יִגַּשׁ לְהַקְרִיב אֶת־אִשֵּׁי יְהוָה מוּם בּוֹ אֵת לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו לֹא יִגַּשׁ לְהַקְרִיב׃

verses.english: He may eat the bread of his God, both from the most holy things and from the holy things.
verses.hebrew: לֶחֶם אֱלֹהָיו מִקָּדְשֵׁי הַקֳּדָשִׁים וּמִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁים יֹאכֵל׃

verses.english: But he shall not enter toward the curtain or approach the altar, because he has a blemish. He shall not profane My sanctuaries, for I am YHWH who sanctifies them.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶל־הַפָּרֹכֶת לֹא יָבֹא וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יִגַּשׁ כִּי־מוּם בּוֹ וְלֹא יְחַלֵּל אֶת־מִקְדָּשַׁי כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

verses.english: Moses spoke to Aaron, to his sons, and to all the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל־אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל־בָּנָיו וְאֶל־כָּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to Aaron and his sons, that they keep apart from the holy things of the sons of Israel, which they consecrate to Me, and not profane My holy name. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל־בָּנָיו וְיִנָּזְרוּ מִקָּדְשֵׁי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם קָדְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר הֵם מַקְדִּשִׁים לִי אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Say to them: Throughout your generations, any man among all your offspring who approaches the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate to YHWH while his uncleanness is upon him—that person shall be cut off from before Me. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר אֲלֵהֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם כָּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרַב מִכָּל־זַרְעֲכֶם אֶל־הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יַקְדִּישׁוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהוָה וְטֻמְאָתוֹ עָלָיו וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִלְּפָנַי אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Any man among Aaron’s offspring who has leprosy or a discharge shall not eat the holy things until he becomes clean. Nor shall one who touches anything unclean through a dead person, or a man from whom an emission of semen goes out,
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִזֶּרַע אַהֲרֹן וְהוּא צָרוּעַ אוֹ זָב בַּקֳּדָשִׁים לֹא יֹאכַל עַד אֲשֶׁר יִטְהָר וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בְּכָל־טְמֵא־נֶפֶשׁ אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־תֵּצֵא מִמֶּנּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זָרַע׃

verses.english: or a man who touches any swarming creature through which he becomes unclean, or a human being through whom he becomes unclean, whatever that uncleanness may be.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכָל־שֶׁרֶץ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא־לוֹ אוֹ בְאָדָם אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא־לוֹ לְכֹל טֻמְאָתוֹ׃

verses.english: A person who touches any such thing shall be unclean until evening. He shall not eat the holy things unless he has washed his flesh with water.
verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּגַּע־בּוֹ וְטָמְאָה עַד־הָעָרֶב וְלֹא יֹאכַל מִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁים כִּי אִם־רָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם׃

verses.english: When the sun sets, he shall be clean; afterward he may eat the holy things, for they are his bread.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְטָהֵר וְאַחַר יֹאכַל מִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁים כִּי לַחְמוֹ הוּא׃

verses.english: He shall not eat an animal found dead or torn by beasts, becoming unclean through it. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: נְבֵלָה וּטְרֵפָה לֹא יֹאכַל לְטָמְאָה־בָהּ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: They shall keep My charge, so that they do not bear sin because of it and die through it by profaning it. I am YHWH who sanctifies them.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּי וְלֹא־יִשְׂאוּ עָלָיו חֵטְא וּמֵתוּ בוֹ כִּי יְחַלְּלֻהוּ אֲנִי יְהוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

verses.english: No outsider shall eat a holy thing. A priest’s lodger or hired worker shall not eat a holy thing.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־זָר לֹא־יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ תּוֹשַׁב כֹּהֵן וְשָׂכִיר לֹא־יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: But if a priest buys a person with his own silver, that person may eat of it; those born in his house may also eat his bread.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹהֵן כִּי־יִקְנֶה נֶפֶשׁ קִנְיַן כַּסְפּוֹ הוּא יֹאכַל בּוֹ וִילִיד בֵּיתוֹ הֵם יֹאכְלוּ בְלַחְמוֹ׃

verses.english: If a priest’s daughter marries an outsider, she shall not eat the contribution of the holy things.
verses.hebrew: וּבַת־כֹּהֵן כִּי תִהְיֶה לְאִישׁ זָר הִוא בִּתְרוּמַת הַקֳּדָשִׁים לֹא תֹאכֵל׃

verses.english: If a priest’s daughter becomes a widow or is divorced, has no offspring, and returns to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat her father’s bread. But no outsider shall eat of it.
verses.hebrew: וּבַת־כֹּהֵן כִּי תִהְיֶה אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה וְזֶרַע אֵין לָהּ וְשָׁבָה אֶל־בֵּית אָבִיהָ כִּנְעוּרֶיהָ מִלֶּחֶם אָבִיהָ תֹּאכֵל וְכָל־זָר לֹא־יֹאכַל בּוֹ׃

verses.english: If a man eats a holy thing unintentionally, he shall add a fifth to it and give the holy thing to the priest.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי־יֹאכַל קֹדֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה וְיָסַף חֲמִשִׁיתוֹ עָלָיו וְנָתַן לַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: They shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel that they lift up to YHWH,
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יְחַלְּלוּ אֶת־קָדְשֵׁי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יָרִימוּ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: and so make them bear the guilt of an offense by eating their holy things, for I am YHWH who sanctifies them.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשִּׂיאוּ אוֹתָם עֲוֺן אַשְׁמָה בְּאָכְלָם אֶת־קָדְשֵׁיהֶם כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה מְקַדְּשָׁם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to Aaron, his sons, and all the sons of Israel, and say to them: Any man of the house of Israel or of the resident foreigners in Israel who presents his offering, for any of their vows or any of their freewill offerings that they present to YHWH as a burnt offering,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל־בָּנָיו וְאֶל כָּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן־הַגֵּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב קָרְבָּנוֹ לְכָל־נִדְרֵיהֶם וּלְכָל־נִדְבוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהוָה לְעֹלָה׃

verses.english: for your acceptance it shall be a male without blemish, from the cattle, the sheep, or the goats.
verses.hebrew: לִרְצֹנְכֶם תָּמִים זָכָר בַּבָּקָר בַּכְּשָׂבִים וּבָעִזִּים׃

verses.english: You shall not present anything with a blemish, for it will not be accepted for you.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ מוּם לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ כִּי־לֹא לְרָצוֹן יִהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

verses.english: If a man presents a sacrifice of well-being to YHWH to fulfill a special vow or as a freewill offering, from the cattle or the flock, it shall be unblemished to be accepted; there shall be no blemish in it.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי־יַקְרִיב זֶבַח־שְׁלָמִים לַיהוָה לְפַלֵּא־נֶדֶר אוֹ לִנְדָבָה בַּבָּקָר אוֹ בַצֹּאן תָּמִים יִהְיֶה לְרָצוֹן כָּל־מוּם לֹא יִהְיֶה־בּוֹ׃

verses.english: You shall not present to YHWH an animal that is blind, broken, mutilated, has a wart, a scab, or a skin eruption. You shall not place any of these on the altar as an offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: עַוֶּרֶת אוֹ שָׁבוּר אוֹ־חָרוּץ אוֹ־יַבֶּלֶת אוֹ גָרָב אוֹ יַלֶּפֶת לֹא־תַקְרִיבוּ אֵלֶּה לַיהוָה וְאִשֶּׁה לֹא־תִתְּנוּ מֵהֶם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: An ox or a sheep with an overgrown or stunted member you may make a freewill offering, but it will not be accepted for a vow.
verses.hebrew: וְשׁוֹר וָשֶׂה שָׂרוּעַ וְקָלוּט נְדָבָה תַּעֲשֶׂה אֹתוֹ וּלְנֵדֶר לֹא יֵרָצֶה׃

verses.english: You shall not present to YHWH an animal whose testicles are bruised, crushed, torn away, or cut off; neither shall you do this in your land.
verses.hebrew: וּמָעוּךְ וְכָתוּת וְנָתוּק וְכָרוּת לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ לַיהוָה וּבְאַרְצְכֶם לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: You shall not present any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, for their damage is in them; they have a blemish. They will not be accepted for you.
verses.hebrew: וּמִיַּד בֶּן־נֵכָר לֹא תַקְרִיבוּ אֶת־לֶחֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶם מִכָּל־אֵלֶּה כִּי מָשְׁחָתָם בָּהֶם מוּם בָּם לֹא יֵרָצוּ לָכֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: When an ox, sheep, or goat is born, it shall remain under its mother for seven days. From the eighth day onward it may be accepted as an offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: שׁוֹר אוֹ־כֶשֶׂב אוֹ־עֵז כִּי יִוָּלֵד וְהָיָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תַּחַת אִמּוֹ וּמִיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי וָהָלְאָה יֵרָצֶה לְקָרְבַּן אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: You shall not slaughter an ox or a sheep together with its young on the same day.
verses.hebrew: וְשׁוֹר אוֹ־שֶׂה אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־בְּנוֹ לֹא תִשְׁחֲטוּ בְּיוֹם אֶחָד׃

verses.english: When you sacrifice a thanksgiving sacrifice to YHWH, sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־תִזְבְּחוּ זֶבַח־תּוֹדָה לַיהוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם תִּזְבָּחוּ׃

verses.english: It shall be eaten that same day. You shall leave none of it until morning. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יֵאָכֵל לֹא־תוֹתִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד־בֹּקֶר אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Keep My commandments and do them. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם מִצְוֺתַי וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: You shall not profane My holy name, and I will be sanctified among the sons of Israel. I am YHWH who sanctifies you,
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תְחַלְּלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם קָדְשִׁי וְנִקְדַּשְׁתִּי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנִי יְהוָה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם׃

verses.english: who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: הַמּוֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: YHWH’s appointed times, which you shall proclaim as holy convocations—these are My appointed times.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם מוֹעֲדֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ אֵלֶּה הֵם מוֹעֲדָי׃

verses.english: Work may be done for six days, but on the seventh day there shall be a Sabbath of complete rest, a holy convocation. You shall do no work. It is a Sabbath to YHWH in all your dwellings.
verses.hebrew: שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים תֵּעָשֶׂה מְלָאכָה וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ כָּל־מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ שַׁבָּת הִוא לַיהוָה בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: These are YHWH’s appointed times, holy convocations, which you shall proclaim at their appointed time.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מוֹעֲדֵי יְהוָה מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם בְּמוֹעֲדָם׃

verses.english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between the evenings, is YHWH’s Passover.
verses.hebrew: בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם פֶּסַח לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: On the fifteenth day of this month is the Festival of Unleavened Bread to YHWH. You shall eat unleavened bread for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חַג הַמַּצּוֹת לַיהוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

verses.english: On the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no laborious work.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: You shall present an offering by fire to YHWH for seven days. On the seventh day there shall be a holy convocation; you shall do no laborious work.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: When you enter the land that I am giving you and reap its harvest, you shall bring a sheaf of the first of your harvest to the priest.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי־תָבֹאוּ אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם וּקְצַרְתֶּם אֶת־קְצִירָהּ וַהֲבֵאתֶם אֶת־עֹמֶר רֵאשִׁית קְצִירְכֶם אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: He shall wave the sheaf before YHWH for your acceptance. On the day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵנִיף אֶת־הָעֹמֶר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם מִמָּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת יְנִיפֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: On the day you wave the sheaf, you shall offer an unblemished year-old lamb as a burnt offering to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם בְּיוֹם הֲנִיפְכֶם אֶת־הָעֹמֶר כֶּבֶשׂ תָּמִים בֶּן־שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: Its grain offering shall be two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering by fire to YHWH, a pleasing aroma. Its drink offering shall be wine, a quarter of a hin.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתוֹ שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ וְנִסְכֹּה יַיִן רְבִיעִת הַהִין׃

verses.english: You shall eat neither bread nor roasted grain nor fresh grain until that very day, until you bring the offering of your God. This is a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.hebrew: וְלֶחֶם וְקָלִי וְכַרְמֶל לֹא תֹאכְלוּ עַד־עֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עַד הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת־קָרְבַּן אֱלֹהֵיכֶם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Count for yourselves from the day after the Sabbath, from the day you bring the sheaf of the wave offering: there shall be seven complete Sabbaths.
verses.hebrew: וּסְפַרְתֶּם לָכֶם מִמָּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת מִיּוֹם הֲבִיאֲכֶם אֶת־עֹמֶר הַתְּנוּפָה שֶׁבַע שַׁבָּתוֹת תְּמִימֹת תִּהְיֶינָה׃

verses.english: Until the day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days, and then present a new grain offering to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: עַד מִמָּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת הַשְּׁבִיעִת תִּסְפְּרוּ חֲמִשִּׁים יוֹם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: From your dwellings you shall bring two loaves as a wave offering. They shall be of two tenths of fine flour, baked with leaven, as firstfruits to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מִמּוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם תָּבִיאּוּ לֶחֶם תְּנוּפָה שְׁתַּיִם שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת תִּהְיֶינָה חָמֵץ תֵּאָפֶינָה בִּכּוּרִים לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: With the bread you shall present seven unblemished year-old lambs, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to YHWH, with their grain offerings and drink offerings, an offering by fire, a pleasing aroma to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עַל־הַלֶּחֶם שִׁבְעַת כְּבָשִׂים תְּמִימִם בְּנֵי שָׁנָה וּפַר בֶּן־בָּקָר אֶחָד וְאֵילִם שְׁנָיִם יִהְיוּ עֹלָה לַיהוָה וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ־נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: You shall offer one male goat as a sin offering and two year-old lambs as a sacrifice of well-being.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם שְׂעִיר־עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וּשְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה לְזֶבַח שְׁלָמִים׃

verses.english: The priest shall wave them with the firstfruits bread as a wave offering before YHWH, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to YHWH for the priest.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵנִיף הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם עַל לֶחֶם הַבִּכּוּרִים תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה עַל־שְׁנֵי כְּבָשִׂים קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיוּ לַיהוָה לַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: You shall proclaim on that very day a holy convocation for yourselves. You shall do no laborious work. This is a perpetual statute in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.hebrew: וּקְרָאתֶם בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם בְּכָל־מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not finish reaping the edge of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. Leave them for the poor and the resident foreigner. I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת־קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא־תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ בְּקֻצְרֶךָ וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a rest, a memorial of a sounding blast, a holy convocation.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם שַׁבָּתוֹן זִכְרוֹן תְּרוּעָה מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: You shall do no laborious work, and you shall present an offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Now on the tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. You shall have a holy convocation, afflict yourselves, and present an offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הַזֶּה יוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים הוּא מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: You shall do no work on that very day, for it is a Day of Atonement, to make atonement for you before YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי יוֹם כִּפֻּרִים הוּא לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Any person who does not afflict himself on that very day shall be cut off from his people.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כָל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תְעֻנֶּה בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וְנִכְרְתָה מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃

verses.english: Any person who does any work on that very day—I will destroy that person from among his people.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה כָּל־מְלָאכָה בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי אֶת־הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

verses.english: You shall do no work. This is a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: It shall be a Sabbath of complete rest for you, and you shall afflict yourselves. On the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.
verses.hebrew: שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן הוּא לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם בְּתִשְׁעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ בָּעֶרֶב מֵעֶרֶב עַד־עֶרֶב תִּשְׁבְּתוּ שַׁבַּתְּכֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the Festival of Booths to YHWH for seven days.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הַזֶּה חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לַיהֹוָה׃

verses.english: On the first day there shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no laborious work.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: For seven days you shall present an offering by fire to YHWH. On the eighth day you shall have a holy convocation and present an offering by fire to YHWH. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no laborious work.
verses.hebrew: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תַּקְרִיבוּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה עֲצֶרֶת הִוא כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: These are YHWH’s appointed times, which you shall proclaim as holy convocations, to present an offering by fire to YHWH: burnt offering and grain offering, sacrifice and drink offerings, each day’s requirement on its day,
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מוֹעֲדֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־תִּקְרְאוּ אֹתָם מִקְרָאֵי קֹדֶשׁ לְהַקְרִיב אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה עֹלָה וּמִנְחָה זֶבַח וּנְסָכִים דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: besides YHWH’s Sabbaths, besides your gifts, besides all your vows, and besides all your freewill offerings that you give to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מִלְּבַד שַׁבְּתֹת יְּהוָה וּמִלְּבַד מַתְּנוֹתֵיכֶם וּמִלְּבַד כָּל־נִדְרֵיכֶם וּמִלְּבַד כָּל־נִדְבוֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you gather the produce of the land, you shall celebrate YHWH’s festival for seven days. On the first day there shall be rest, and on the eighth day there shall be rest.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאָסְפְּכֶם אֶת־תְּבוּאַת הָאָרֶץ תָּחֹגּוּ אֶת־חַג־יְהוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן שַׁבָּתוֹן וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי שַׁבָּתוֹן׃

verses.english: On the first day you shall take for yourselves fruit of a splendid tree, palm fronds, branches of leafy trees, and willows of the stream. You shall rejoice before YHWH your God for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וּלְקַחְתֶּם לָכֶם בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן פְּרִי עֵץ הָדָר כַּפֹּת תְּמָרִים וַעֲנַף עֵץ־עָבֹת וְעַרְבֵי־נָחַל וּשְׂמַחְתֶּם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: You shall celebrate it as a festival to YHWH for seven days each year. This is a perpetual statute throughout your generations; you shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.hebrew: וְחַגֹּתֶם אֹתוֹ חַג לַיהוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי תָּחֹגּוּ אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: You shall dwell in booths for seven days. All the native-born in Israel shall dwell in booths,
verses.hebrew: בַּסֻּכֹּת תֵּשְׁבוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כָּל־הָאֶזְרָח בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יֵשְׁבוּ בַּסֻּכֹּת׃

verses.english: so that your generations may know that I made the sons of Israel dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דֹרֹתֵיכֶם כִּי בַסֻּכּוֹת הוֹשַׁבְתִּי אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהוֹצִיאִי אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Moses declared YHWH’s appointed times to the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת־מֹעֲדֵי יְהוָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Command the sons of Israel to bring you pure beaten olive oil for the light, to keep a lamp burning continually.
verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן זַיִת זָךְ כָּתִית לַמָּאוֹר לְהַעֲלֹת נֵר תָּמִיד׃

verses.english: Outside the curtain of the testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall arrange it from evening to morning before YHWH continually. This is a perpetual statute throughout your generations.
verses.hebrew: מִחוּץ לְפָרֹכֶת הָעֵדֻת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יַעֲרֹךְ אֹתוֹ אַהֲרֹן מֵעֶרֶב עַד־בֹּקֶר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה תָּמִיד חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: He shall arrange the lamps upon the pure lampstand before YHWH continually.
verses.hebrew: עַל הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה יַעֲרֹךְ אֶת־הַנֵּרוֹת לִפְנֵי יְהוָה תָּמִיד׃

verses.english: You shall take fine flour and bake twelve cakes from it. Each cake shall contain two tenths.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ סֹלֶת וְאָפִיתָ אֹתָהּ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה חַלּוֹת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים יִהְיֶה הַחַלָּה הָאֶחָת׃

verses.english: You shall place them in two arrangements, six in each arrangement, on the pure table before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ אוֹתָם שְׁתַּיִם מַעֲרָכוֹת שֵׁשׁ הַמַּעֲרָכֶת עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן הַטָּהֹר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: You shall put pure frankincense upon the arrangement, and it shall serve as a memorial portion for the bread, an offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ עַל־הַמַּעֲרֶכֶת לְבֹנָה זַכָּה וְהָיְתָה לַלֶּחֶם לְאַזְכָּרָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: Sabbath by Sabbath he shall arrange it before YHWH continually, from the sons of Israel as a perpetual covenant.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת יַעַרְכֶנּוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה תָּמִיד מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: It shall belong to Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat it in a holy place, for it is most holy for him from YHWH’s offerings by fire, a perpetual due.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו וַאֲכָלֻהוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ כִּי קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים הוּא לוֹ מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהוָה חָק־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian man, went out among the sons of Israel. The Israelite woman’s son and an Israelite man fought in the camp.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא בֶּן־אִשָּׁה יִשְׂרְאֵלִית וְהוּא בֶּן־אִישׁ מִצְרִי בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּנָּצוּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה בֶּן הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית וְאִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי׃

verses.english: The Israelite woman’s son blasphemed the Name and cursed, and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקֹּב בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית אֶת־הַשֵּׁם וַיְקַלֵּל וַיָּבִיאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְשֵׁם אִמּוֹ שְׁלֹמִית בַּת־דִּבְרִי לְמַטֵּה־דָן׃

verses.english: They placed him in custody, so that a decision might be made clear to them by the mouth of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּנִּיחֻהוּ בַּמִּשְׁמָר לִפְרֹשׁ לָהֶם עַל־פִּי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Bring the one who cursed outside the camp. All who heard him shall lay their hands on his head, and the whole congregation shall stone him.
verses.hebrew: הוֹצֵא אֶת־הַמְקַלֵּל אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְסָמְכוּ כָל־הַשֹּׁמְעִים אֶת־יְדֵיהֶם עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וְרָגְמוּ אֹתוֹ כָּל־הָעֵדָה׃

verses.english: You shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying: Any man who curses his God shall bear his sin.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי־יְקַלֵּל אֱלֹהָיו וְנָשָׂא חֶטְאוֹ׃

verses.english: One who blasphemes YHWH’s name shall surely be put to death. The whole congregation shall surely stone him. Whether resident foreigner or native-born, when he blasphemes the Name he shall be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְנֹקֵב שֵׁם־יְהוָה מוֹת יוּמָת רָגוֹם יִרְגְּמוּ־בוֹ כָּל־הָעֵדָה כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח בְּנָקְבוֹ־שֵׁם יוּמָת׃

verses.english: If a man strikes down any human life, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי יַכֶּה כָּל־נֶפֶשׁ אָדָם מוֹת יוּמָת׃

verses.english: One who strikes down an animal’s life shall make restitution for it, life for life.
verses.hebrew: וּמַכֵּה נֶפֶשׁ־בְּהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה נֶפֶשׁ תַּחַת נָפֶשׁ׃

verses.english: If a man causes a blemish in his fellow, as he has done, so shall it be done to him:
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי־יִתֵּן מוּם בַּעֲמִיתוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה כֵּן יֵעָשֶׂה לּוֹ׃

verses.english: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. As he has caused a blemish in a human being, so shall it be inflicted upon him.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁבֶר תַּחַת שֶׁבֶר עַיִן תַּחַת עַיִן שֵׁן תַּחַת שֵׁן כַּאֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מוּם בָּאָדָם כֵּן יִנָּתֶן בּוֹ׃

verses.english: One who strikes down an animal shall make restitution for it, but one who strikes down a human being shall be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וּמַכֵּה בְהֵמָה יְשַׁלְּמֶנָּה וּמַכֵּה אָדָם יוּמָת׃

verses.english: You shall have one judgment for the resident foreigner and the native-born alike, for I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: מִשְׁפַּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כַּגֵּר כָּאֶזְרָח יִהְיֶה כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Moses spoke to the sons of Israel. They brought the one who cursed outside the camp and stoned him with stones. The sons of Israel did as YHWH commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיּוֹצִיאוּ אֶת־הַמְקַלֵּל אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ אָבֶן וּבְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: When you enter the land that I am giving you, the land shall keep a Sabbath to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם וְשָׁבְתָה הָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: For six years you shall sow your field, and for six years you shall prune your vineyard and gather its produce.
verses.hebrew: שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְרַע שָׂדֶךָ וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים תִּזְמֹר כַּרְמֶךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ אֶת־תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

verses.english: But in the seventh year the land shall have a Sabbath of complete rest, a Sabbath to YHWH. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.
verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת לַיהוָה שָׂדְךָ לֹא תִזְרָע וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תִזְמֹר׃

verses.english: You shall not reap the self-grown produce of your harvest or gather the grapes of your untended vine. It shall be a year of complete rest for the land.
verses.hebrew: אֵת סְפִיחַ קְצִירְךָ לֹא תִקְצוֹר וְאֶת־עִנְּבֵי נְזִירֶךָ לֹא תִבְצֹר שְׁנַת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: The land’s Sabbath produce shall be food for you: for you, your male slave, your female slave, your hired worker, and your lodger who resides with you.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה שַׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ לָכֶם לְאָכְלָה לְךָ וּלְעַבְדְּךָ וְלַאֲמָתֶךָ וְלִשְׂכִירְךָ וּלְתוֹשָׁבְךָ הַגָּרִים עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: All its produce shall also be food for your livestock and the wild animals in your land.
verses.hebrew: וְלִבְהֶמְתְּךָ וְלַחַיָּה אֲשֶׁר בְּאַרְצֶךָ תִּהְיֶה כָל־תְּבוּאָתָהּ לֶאֱכֹל׃

verses.english: Count for yourself seven Sabbaths of years, seven years seven times. The days of the seven Sabbaths of years shall amount to forty-nine years for you.
verses.hebrew: וְסָפַרְתָּ לְךָ שֶׁבַע שַׁבְּתֹת שָׁנִים שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וְהָיוּ לְךָ יְמֵי שֶׁבַע שַׁבְּתֹת הַשָּׁנִים תֵּשַׁע וְאַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃

verses.english: You shall sound the horn with a blast in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the horn throughout your land.
verses.hebrew: וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ שׁוֹפַר תְּרוּעָה בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִי בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ בְּיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים תַּעֲבִירוּ שׁוֹפָר בְּכָל־אַרְצְכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty in the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a Jubilee for you. Each of you shall return to his possession, and each shall return to his family.
verses.hebrew: וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּם אֵת שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּקְרָאתֶם דְּרוֹר בָּאָרֶץ לְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶיהָ יוֹבֵל הִוא תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם אִישׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזָּתוֹ וְאִישׁ אֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ תָּשֻׁבוּ׃

verses.english: The fiftieth year shall be a Jubilee for you. You shall not sow, reap its self-grown produce, or gather its untended vines.
verses.hebrew: יוֹבֵל הִוא שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם לֹא תִזְרָעוּ וְלֹא תִקְצְרוּ אֶת־סְפִיחֶיהָ וְלֹא תִבְצְרוּ אֶת־נְזִרֶיהָ׃

verses.english: For it is a Jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat its produce from the field.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יוֹבֵל הִוא קֹדֶשׁ תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם מִן־הַשָּׂדֶה תֹּאכְלוּ אֶת־תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

verses.english: In this year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his possession.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל הַזֹּאת תָּשֻׁבוּ אִישׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: When you sell property to your fellow or buy from your fellow’s hand, you shall not wrong one another.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־תִמְכְּרוּ מִמְכָּר לַעֲמִיתֶךָ אוֹ קָנֹה מִיַּד עֲמִיתֶךָ אַל־תּוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת־אָחִיו׃

verses.english: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your fellow; according to the number of harvest years he shall sell to you.
verses.hebrew: בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים אַחַר הַיּוֹבֵל תִּקְנֶה מֵאֵת עֲמִיתֶךָ בְּמִסְפַּר שְׁנֵי־תְבוּאֹת יִמְכָּר־לָךְ׃

verses.english: As the years increase, you shall increase its purchase price; as the years decrease, you shall decrease its purchase price, for he is selling you a number of harvests.
verses.hebrew: לְפִי רֹב הַשָּׁנִים תַּרְבֶּה מִקְנָתוֹ וּלְפִי מְעֹט הַשָּׁנִים תַּמְעִיט מִקְנָתוֹ כִּי מִסְפַּר תְּבוּאֹת הוּא מֹכֵר לָךְ׃

verses.english: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God, for I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תוֹנוּ אִישׁ אֶת־עֲמִיתוֹ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall do My statutes, keep My judgments, and do them; then you shall dwell securely on the land.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת־חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וִישַׁבְתֶּם עַל־הָאָרֶץ לָבֶטַח׃

verses.english: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat to satisfaction and dwell securely upon it.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ פִּרְיָהּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לָשֹׂבַע וִישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח עָלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: If you say, “What shall we eat in the seventh year? Look, we shall neither sow nor gather our produce,”
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תֹאמְרוּ מַה־נֹּאכַל בַּשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁבִיעִת הֵן לֹא נִזְרָע וְלֹא נֶאֱסֹף אֶת־תְּבוּאָתֵנוּ׃

verses.english: I will command My blessing for you in the sixth year, and it shall produce a harvest for three years.
verses.hebrew: וְצִוִּיתִי אֶת־בִּרְכָתִי לָכֶם בַּשָּׁנָה הַשִּׁשִּׁית וְעָשָׂת אֶת־הַתְּבוּאָה לִשְׁלֹשׁ הַשָּׁנִים׃

verses.english: You shall sow in the eighth year and eat from the old produce. Until the ninth year, until its produce comes in, you shall eat the old.
verses.hebrew: וּזְרַעְתֶּם אֵת הַשָּׁנָה הַשְּׁמִינִת וַאֲכַלְתֶּם מִן־הַתְּבוּאָה יָשָׁן עַד הַשָּׁנָה הַתְּשִׁיעִת עַד־בּוֹא תְּבוּאָתָהּ תֹּאכְלוּ יָשָׁן׃

verses.english: The land shall not be sold permanently, for the land is Mine; you are resident foreigners and lodgers with Me.
verses.hebrew: וְהָאָרֶץ לֹא תִמָּכֵר לִצְמִתֻת כִּי־לִי הָאָרֶץ כִּי־גֵרִים וְתוֹשָׁבִים אַתֶּם עִמָּדִי׃

verses.english: Throughout all the land of your possession, you shall allow redemption of the land.
verses.hebrew: וּבְכֹל אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם גְּאֻלָּה תִּתְּנוּ לָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: If your brother becomes poor and sells some of his possession, his nearest redeemer shall come and redeem what his brother sold.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָכַר מֵאֲחֻזָּתוֹ וּבָא גֹאֲלוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו וְגָאַל אֵת מִמְכַּר אָחִיו׃

verses.english: If a man has no redeemer but his hand gains the means and he finds enough for his redemption,
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי לֹא יִהְיֶה־לּוֹ גֹּאֵל וְהִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ וּמָצָא כְּדֵי גְאֻלָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: he shall calculate the years since his sale and return the balance to the man to whom he sold it; then he shall return to his possession.
verses.hebrew: וְחִשַּׁב אֶת־שְׁנֵי מִמְכָּרוֹ וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת־הָעֹדֵף לָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר מָכַר־לוֹ וְשָׁב לַאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: If his hand does not find enough to repay him, what he sold shall remain in the buyer’s hand until the year of Jubilee. It shall be released in the Jubilee, and he shall return to his possession.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא־מָצְאָה יָדוֹ דֵּי הָשִׁיב לוֹ וְהָיָה מִמְכָּרוֹ בְּיַד הַקֹּנֶה אֹתוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל וְיָצָא בַּיֹּבֵל וְשָׁב לַאֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, its redemption shall remain possible until the end of the year of its sale; its redemption period shall be a full year of days.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי־יִמְכֹּר בֵּית־מוֹשַׁב עִיר חוֹמָה וְהָיְתָה גְּאֻלָּתוֹ עַד־תֹּם שְׁנַת מִמְכָּרוֹ יָמִים תִּהְיֶה גְאֻלָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: If it is not redeemed before a whole year is complete, the house in the city that has a wall shall belong permanently to its buyer throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא־יִגָּאֵל עַד־מְלֹאת לוֹ שָׁנָה תְמִימָה וְקָם הַבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּעִיר אֲשֶׁר־לא [לוֹ] חֹמָה לַצְּמִיתֻת לַקֹּנֶה אֹתוֹ לְדֹרֹתָיו לֹא יֵצֵא בַּיֹּבֵל׃

verses.english: But houses in villages that have no surrounding wall shall be reckoned with the fields of the land. They may be redeemed and shall be released in the Jubilee.
verses.hebrew: וּבָתֵּי הַחֲצֵרִים אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לָהֶם חֹמָה סָבִיב עַל־שְׂדֵה הָאָרֶץ יֵחָשֵׁב גְּאֻלָּה תִּהְיֶה־לּוֹ וּבַיֹּבֵל יֵצֵא׃

verses.english: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites shall have a perpetual right of redemption for the houses of the cities they possess.
verses.hebrew: וְעָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם בָּתֵּי עָרֵי אֲחֻזָּתָם גְּאֻלַּת עוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה לַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: Whatever one redeems from the Levites, the sale of a house in the city of their possession shall be released in the Jubilee, for the houses in the Levites’ cities are their possession among the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר יִגְאַל מִן־הַלְוִיִּם וְיָצָא מִמְכַּר־בַּיִת וְעִיר אֲחֻזָּתוֹ בַּיֹּבֵל כִּי בָתֵּי עָרֵי הַלְוִיִּם הִוא אֲחֻזָּתָם בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The pastureland of their cities shall not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂדֵה מִגְרַשׁ עָרֵיהֶם לֹא יִמָּכֵר כִּי־אֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם הוּא לָהֶם׃

verses.english: If your brother becomes poor and his hand falters beside you, you shall support him as a resident foreigner and a lodger, so that he may live with you.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ וּמָטָה יָדוֹ עִמָּךְ וְהֶחֱזַקְתָּ בּוֹ גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב וָחַי עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: You shall take no interest or increase from him, but fear your God, so that your brother may live with you.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּקַּח מֵאִתּוֹ נֶשֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ וְחֵי אָחִיךָ עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: You shall not give him your silver at interest or give your food for an increase.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־כַּסְפְּךָ לֹא־תִתֵּן לוֹ בְּנֶשֶׁךְ וּבְמַרְבִּית לֹא־תִתֵּן אָכְלֶךָ׃

verses.english: I am YHWH your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לָתֵת לָכֶם אֶת־אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃

verses.english: If your brother becomes poor beside you and is sold to you, you shall not make him perform the service of a slave.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־יָמוּךְ אָחִיךָ עִמָּךְ וְנִמְכַּר־לָךְ לֹא־תַעֲבֹד בּוֹ עֲבֹדַת עָבֶד׃

verses.english: He shall be with you as a hired worker and a lodger; he shall work with you until the year of Jubilee.
verses.hebrew: כְּשָׂכִיר כְּתוֹשָׁב יִהְיֶה עִמָּךְ עַד־שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל יַעֲבֹד עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: Then he shall go out from you, he and his sons with him. He shall return to his family and return to the possession of his fathers.
verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא מֵעִמָּךְ הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּוֹ וְשָׁב אֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְאֶל־אֲחֻזַּת אֲבֹתָיו יָשׁוּב׃

verses.english: For they are My slaves, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; they shall not be sold in a slave sale.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עֲבָדַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵאתִי אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם לֹא יִמָּכְרוּ מִמְכֶּרֶת עָבֶד׃

verses.english: You shall not rule over him ruthlessly, but shall fear your God.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ וְיָרֵאתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Your male and female slaves may come from the nations around you; from them you may buy a male slave or a female slave.
verses.hebrew: וְעַבְדְּךָ וַאֲמָתְךָ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיוּ־לָךְ מֵאֵת הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיכֶם מֵהֶם תִּקְנוּ עֶבֶד וְאָמָה׃

verses.english: You may also buy from the sons of the lodgers residing with you, and from their families with you whom they have begotten in your land; they shall become your possession.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם מִבְּנֵי הַתּוֹשָׁבִים הַגָּרִים עִמָּכֶם מֵהֶם תִּקְנוּ וּמִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם אֲשֶׁר עִמָּכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹלִידוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

verses.english: You may bequeath them to your sons after you as an inherited possession; you may make them serve permanently. But among your brothers, the sons of Israel, no one shall rule over his brother ruthlessly.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְנַחֲלְתֶּם אֹתָם לִבְנֵיכֶם אַחֲרֵיכֶם לָרֶשֶׁת אֲחֻזָּה לְעֹלָם בָּהֶם תַּעֲבֹדוּ וּבְאַחֵיכֶם בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ בְּאָחִיו לֹא־תִרְדֶּה בוֹ בְּפָרֶךְ׃

verses.english: If a resident foreigner or lodger beside you gains means, and your brother beside him becomes poor and is sold to a resident foreigner lodging with you or to a member of a foreigner’s family,
verses.hebrew: וְכִי תַשִּׂיג יַד גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב עִמָּךְ וּמָךְ אָחִיךָ עִמּוֹ וְנִמְכַּר לְגֵר תּוֹשָׁב עִמָּךְ אוֹ לְעֵקֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת גֵּר׃

verses.english: after he is sold, he shall have a right of redemption. One of his brothers may redeem him,
verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי נִמְכַּר גְּאֻלָּה תִּהְיֶה־לּוֹ אֶחָד מֵאֶחָיו יִגְאָלֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: or his uncle or his uncle’s son may redeem him, or a close blood relative from his family may redeem him; or, if his hand gains the means, he may redeem himself.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ־דֹדוֹ אוֹ בֶן־דֹּדוֹ יִגְאָלֶנּוּ אוֹ־מִשְּׁאֵר בְּשָׂרוֹ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ יִגְאָלֶנּוּ אוֹ־הִשִּׂיגָה יָדוֹ וְנִגְאָל׃

verses.english: He shall calculate with his buyer from the year he was sold to him until the year of Jubilee. His sale price shall be apportioned by the number of years; his time with him shall be reckoned as a hired worker’s days.
verses.hebrew: וְחִשַּׁב עִם־קֹנֵהוּ מִשְּׁנַת הִמָּכְרוֹ לוֹ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְהָיָה כֶּסֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ בְּמִסְפַּר שָׁנִים כִּימֵי שָׂכִיר יִהְיֶה עִמּוֹ׃

verses.english: If many years remain, he shall repay his redemption price from his purchase money in proportion to them.
verses.hebrew: אִם־עוֹד רַבּוֹת בַּשָּׁנִים לְפִיהֶן יָשִׁיב גְּאֻלָּתוֹ מִכֶּסֶף מִקְנָתוֹ׃

verses.english: If few years remain until the year of Jubilee, he shall calculate with him and repay his redemption price in proportion to his years.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־מְעַט נִשְׁאַר בַּשָּׁנִים עַד־שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְחִשַּׁב־לוֹ כְּפִי שָׁנָיו יָשִׁיב אֶת־גְּאֻלָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: He shall be with him as a hired worker year by year. The buyer shall not rule over him ruthlessly before your eyes.
verses.hebrew: כִּשְׂכִיר שָׁנָה בְּשָׁנָה יִהְיֶה עִמּוֹ לֹא־יִרְדֶּנּוּ בְּפֶרֶךְ לְעֵינֶיךָ׃

verses.english: If he is not redeemed by these means, he shall go out in the year of Jubilee, he and his sons with him.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא יִגָּאֵל בְּאֵלֶּה וְיָצָא בִּשְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל הוּא וּבָנָיו עִמּוֹ׃

verses.english: For the sons of Israel are slaves to Me; they are My slaves, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־לִי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדִים עֲבָדַי הֵם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵאתִי אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or pillar for yourselves. You shall not place a figured stone in your land to bow down upon it, for I am YHWH your God.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תַעֲשׂוּ לָכֶם אֱלִילִם וּפֶסֶל וּמַצֵּבָה לֹא־תָקִימוּ לָכֶם וְאֶבֶן מַשְׂכִּית לֹא תִתְּנוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶם לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת עָלֶיהָ כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall keep My Sabbaths and revere My sanctuary. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁי תִּירָאוּ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: If you walk in My statutes, keep My commandments, and do them,
verses.hebrew: אִם־בְּחֻקֹּתַי תֵּלֵכוּ וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתַי תִּשְׁמְרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם׃

verses.english: I will give your rains in their season. The land shall yield its produce, and the tree of the field shall yield its fruit.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי גִשְׁמֵיכֶם בְּעִתָּם וְנָתְנָה הָאָרֶץ יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה יִתֵּן פִּרְיוֹ׃

verses.english: Your threshing shall reach the grape harvest, and the grape harvest shall reach the sowing. You shall eat your bread to satisfaction and dwell securely in your land.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשִּׂיג לָכֶם דַּיִשׁ אֶת־בָּצִיר וּבָצִיר יַשִּׂיג אֶת־זָרַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּם לַחְמְכֶם לָשֹׂבַע וִישַׁבְתֶּם לָבֶטַח בְּאַרְצְכֶם׃

verses.english: I will give peace in the land. You shall lie down, with no one to frighten you. I will remove harmful animals from the land, and no sword shall pass through your land.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי שָׁלוֹם בָּאָרֶץ וּשְׁכַבְתֶּם וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי חַיָּה רָעָה מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְחֶרֶב לֹא־תַעֲבֹר בְּאַרְצְכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall pursue your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.hebrew: וּרְדַפְתֶּם אֶת־אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְנָפְלוּ לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָרֶב

verses.english: Five of you shall pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you shall pursue ten thousand. Your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.hebrew: וְרָדְפוּ מִכֶּם חֲמִשָּׁה מֵאָה וּמֵאָה מִכֶּם רְבָבָה יִרְדֹּפוּ וְנָפְלוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶם לִפְנֵיכֶם לֶחָרֶב׃

verses.english: I will turn toward you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and establish My covenant with you.
verses.hebrew: וּפָנִיתִי אֲלֵיכֶם וְהִפְרֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם וַהֲקִימֹתִי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall eat long-stored produce and clear out the old before the new.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם יָשָׁן נוֹשָׁן וְיָשָׁן מִפְּנֵי חָדָשׁ תּוֹצִיאוּ׃

verses.english: I will place My dwelling among you, and My soul shall not abhor you.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי מִשְׁכָּנִי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְלֹא־תִגְעַל נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶם׃

verses.english: I will walk among you and be your God, and you shall be My people.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְהָיִיתִי לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ־לִי לְעָם׃

verses.english: I am YHWH your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would no longer be their slaves. I broke the bars of your yoke and made you walk upright.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִהְיֹת לָהֶם עֲבָדִים וָאֶשְׁבֹּר מֹטֹת עֻלְּכֶם וָאוֹלֵךְ אֶתְכֶם קוֹמְמִיּוּת׃

verses.english: But if you do not listen to Me and do not do all these commandments,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֵת כָּל־הַמִּצְוֺת הָאֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: if you reject My statutes and your soul abhors My judgments, so that you do not do all My commandments and thus break My covenant,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בְּחֻקֹּתַי תִּמְאָסוּ וְאִם אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַי תִּגְעַל נַפְשְׁכֶם לְבִלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺתַי לְהַפְרְכֶם אֶת־בְּרִיתִי׃

verses.english: then I Myself will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, wasting disease and fever that consume the eyes and drain the life. You shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.hebrew: אַף־אֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה־זֹּאת לָכֶם וְהִפְקַדְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם בֶּהָלָה אֶת־הַשַּׁחֶפֶת וְאֶת־הַקַּדַּחַת מְכַלּוֹת עֵינַיִם וּמְדִיבֹת נָפֶשׁ וּזְרַעְתֶּם לָרִיק זַרְעֲכֶם וַאֲכָלֻהוּ אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: I will set My face against you, and you shall be struck down before your enemies. Those who hate you shall rule over you, and you shall flee when no one pursues you.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי פָנַי בָּכֶם וְנִגַּפְתֶּם לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְרָדוּ בָכֶם שֹׂנְאֵיכֶם וְנַסְתֶּם וְאֵין־רֹדֵף אֶתְכֶם׃

verses.english: If even after these things you do not listen to Me, I will discipline you sevenfold more for your sins.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־עַד־אֵלֶּה לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וְיָסַפְתִּי לְיַסְּרָה אֶתְכֶם שֶׁבַע עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: I will break the pride of your strength and make your skies like iron and your land like bronze.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁבַרְתִּי אֶת־גְּאוֹן עֻזְּכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־שְׁמֵיכֶם כַּבַּרְזֶל וְאֶת־אַרְצְכֶם כַּנְּחֻשָׁה׃

verses.english: Your strength shall be spent in vain. Your land shall not yield its produce, and the tree of the land shall not yield its fruit.
verses.hebrew: וְתַם לָרִיק כֹּחֲכֶם וְלֹא־תִתֵּן אַרְצְכֶם אֶת־יְבוּלָהּ וְעֵץ הָאָרֶץ לֹא יִתֵּן פִּרְיוֹ׃

verses.english: If you walk contrary to Me and will not listen to Me, I will add sevenfold blows upon you according to your sins.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־תֵּלְכוּ עִמִּי קֶרִי וְלֹא תֹאבוּ לִשְׁמֹעַ לִי וְיָסַפְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַכָּה שֶׁבַע כְּחַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: I will send the animals of the field among you. They shall bereave you, cut off your livestock, and make you few, so that your roads become desolate.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּי בָכֶם אֶת־חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וְשִׁכְּלָה אֶתְכֶם וְהִכְרִיתָה אֶת־בְּהֶמְתְּכֶם וְהִמְעִיטָה אֶתְכֶם וְנָשַׁמּוּ דַּרְכֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: If by these things you are not disciplined toward Me, but continue to walk contrary to Me,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בְּאֵלֶּה לֹא תִוָּסְרוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי קֶרִי׃

verses.english: then I Myself will walk contrary to you, and I Myself will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
verses.hebrew: וְהָלַכְתִּי אַף־אֲנִי עִמָּכֶם בְּקֶרִי וְהִכֵּיתִי אֶתְכֶם גַּם־אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: I will bring upon you a sword avenging the vengeance of the covenant. You shall gather into your cities, and I will send pestilence among you; you shall be given into the enemy’s hand.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבֵאתִי עֲלֵיכֶם חֶרֶב נֹקֶמֶת נְקַם־בְּרִית וְנֶאֱסַפְתֶּם אֶל־עָרֵיכֶם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי דֶבֶר בְּתוֹכְכֶם וְנִתַּתֶּם בְּיַד־אוֹיֵב׃

verses.english: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven and return your bread by weight. You shall eat and not be satisfied.
verses.hebrew: בְּשִׁבְרִי לָכֶם מַטֵּה־לֶחֶם וְאָפוּ עֶשֶׂר נָשִׁים לַחְמְכֶם בְּתַנּוּר אֶחָד וְהֵשִׁיבוּ לַחְמְכֶם בַּמִּשְׁקָל וַאֲכַלְתֶּם וְלֹא תִשְׂבָּעוּ׃

verses.english: If after this you do not listen to Me, but walk contrary to Me,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בְּזֹאת לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ לִי וַהֲלַכְתֶּם עִמִּי בְּקֶרִי׃

verses.english: I will walk against you in furious opposition, and I Myself will discipline you sevenfold for your sins.
verses.hebrew: וְהָלַכְתִּי עִמָּכֶם בַּחֲמַת־קֶרִי וְיִסַּרְתִּי אֶתְכֶם אַף־אָנִי שֶׁבַע עַל־חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters you shall eat.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם בְּשַׂר בְּנֵיכֶם וּבְשַׂר בְּנֹתֵיכֶם תֹּאכֵלוּ׃

verses.english: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and put your carcasses upon the carcasses of your idols. My soul shall abhor you.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֶת־בָּמֹתֵיכֶם וְהִכְרַתִּי אֶת־חַמָּנֵיכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־פִּגְרֵיכֶם עַל־פִּגְרֵי גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם וְגָעֲלָה נַפְשִׁי אֶתְכֶם׃

verses.english: I will make your cities a ruin and desolate your sanctuaries. I will not smell your pleasing aromas.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־עָרֵיכֶם חָרְבָּה וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִי אֶת־מִקְדְּשֵׁיכֶם וְלֹא אָרִיחַ בְּרֵיחַ נִיחֹחֲכֶם׃

verses.english: I Myself will desolate the land, and your enemies who dwell in it shall be appalled at it.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי אֲנִי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְשָׁמְמוּ עָלֶיהָ אֹיְבֵיכֶם הַיֹּשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

verses.english: I will scatter you among the nations and draw a sword after you. Your land shall become desolate, and your cities shall become a ruin.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶתְכֶם אֱזָרֶה בַגּוֹיִם וַהֲרִיקֹתִי אַחֲרֵיכֶם חָרֶב וְהָיְתָה אַרְצְכֶם שְׁמָמָה וְעָרֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ חָרְבָּה׃

verses.english: Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths all the days of its desolation, while you are in your enemies’ land. Then the land shall rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
verses.hebrew: אָז תִּרְצֶה הָאָרֶץ אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ כֹּל יְמֵי הֳשַׁמָּה וְאַתֶּם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶם אָז תִּשְׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ וְהִרְצָת אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: All the days of its desolation it shall rest, the rest it did not have during your Sabbaths when you dwelt upon it.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־יְמֵי הָשַּׁמָּה תִּשְׁבֹּת אֵת אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שָׁבְתָה בְּשַׁבְּתֹתֵיכֶם בְּשִׁבְתְּכֶם עָלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: As for those of you who remain, I will bring faintness into their hearts in their enemies’ lands. The sound of a driven leaf shall pursue them. They shall flee as one flees from a sword and fall when no one pursues.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּכֶם וְהֵבֵאתִי מֹרֶךְ בִּלְבָבָם בְּאַרְצֹת אֹיְבֵיהֶם וְרָדַף אֹתָם קוֹל עָלֶה נִדָּף וְנָסוּ מְנֻסַת־חֶרֶב וְנָפְלוּ וְאֵין רֹדֵף׃

verses.english: They shall stumble over one another as before a sword, though no one pursues. You shall have no standing before your enemies.
verses.hebrew: וְכָשְׁלוּ אִישׁ־בְּאָחִיו כְּמִפְּנֵי־חֶרֶב וְרֹדֵף אָיִן וְלֹא־תִהְיֶה לָכֶם תְּקוּמָה לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall perish among the nations, and your enemies’ land shall devour you.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲבַדְתֶּם בַּגּוֹיִם וְאָכְלָה אֶתְכֶם אֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Those of you who remain shall waste away in their guilt in their enemies’ lands; also in the guilt of their fathers they shall waste away with them.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים בָּכֶם יִמַּקּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם בְּאַרְצֹת אֹיְבֵיכֶם וְאַף בַּעֲוֺנֹת אֲבֹתָם אִתָּם יִמָּקּוּ׃

verses.english: They shall confess their guilt and their fathers’ guilt in the unfaithfulness they committed against Me, and also in walking contrary to Me.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְוַדּוּ אֶת־עֲוֺנָם וְאֶת־עֲוֺן אֲבֹתָם בְּמַעֲלָם אֲשֶׁר מָעֲלוּ־בִי וְאַף אֲשֶׁר־הָלְכוּ עִמִּי בְּקֶרִי׃

verses.english: I too will walk contrary to them and bring them into their enemies’ land. Then perhaps their uncircumcised heart will be humbled, and then they will accept the penalty of their guilt.
verses.hebrew: אַף־אֲנִי אֵלֵךְ עִמָּם בְּקֶרִי וְהֵבֵאתִי אֹתָם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם אוֹ־אָז יִכָּנַע לְבָבָם הֶעָרֵל וְאָז יִרְצוּ אֶת־עֲוֺנָם׃

verses.english: I will remember My covenant with Jacob, and also My covenant with Isaac, and also My covenant with Abraham I will remember; and I will remember the land.
verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתִּי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יַעֲקוֹב וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יִצְחָק וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אַבְרָהָם אֶזְכֹּר וְהָאָרֶץ אֶזְכֹּר׃

verses.english: The land shall be left by them and enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them. They shall accept the penalty of their guilt, because they rejected My judgments and their soul abhorred My statutes.
verses.hebrew: וְהָאָרֶץ תֵּעָזֵב מֵהֶם וְתִרֶץ אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ בָּהְשַׁמָּה מֵהֶם וְהֵם יִרְצוּ אֶת־עֲוֺנָם יַעַן וּבְיַעַן בְּמִשְׁפָּטַי מָאָסוּ וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתַי גָּעֲלָה נַפְשָׁם׃

verses.english: Yet even then, when they are in their enemies’ land, I will not reject them or abhor them so as to finish them off and break My covenant with them, for I am YHWH their God.
verses.hebrew: וְאַף־גַּם־זֹאת בִּהְיוֹתָם בְּאֶרֶץ אֹיְבֵיהֶם לֹא־מְאַסְתִּים וְלֹא־גְעַלְתִּים לְכַלֹּתָם לְהָפֵר בְּרִיתִי אִתָּם כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: I will remember for them the covenant with the former ones, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt before the eyes of the nations to be their God. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּרִית רִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי־אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם לִהְיֹת לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: These are the statutes, the judgments, and the instructions that YHWH set between Himself and the sons of Israel on Mount Sinai through the hand of Moses.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים וְהַתּוֹרֹת אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהוָה בֵּינוֹ וּבֵין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַר סִינַי בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: If a man makes a special vow concerning persons to YHWH according to your valuation,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ כִּי יַפְלִא נֶדֶר בְּעֶרְכְּךָ נְפָשֹׁת לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: your valuation for a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, by the sanctuary shekel.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ הַזָּכָר מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וְעַד בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ חֲמִשִּׁים שֶׁקֶל כֶּסֶף בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: If the person is female, your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־נְקֵבָה הִוא וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁקֶל׃

verses.english: From five years old to twenty years old, your valuation shall be twenty shekels for a male and ten shekels for a female.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִבֶּן־חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְעַד בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ הַזָּכָר עֶשְׂרִים שְׁקָלִים וְלַנְּקֵבָה עֲשֶׂרֶת שְׁקָלִים׃

verses.english: From one month old to five years old, your valuation shall be five shekels of silver for a male and three shekels of silver for a female.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִבֶּן־חֹדֶשׁ וְעַד בֶּן־חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ הַזָּכָר חֲמִשָּׁה שְׁקָלִים כָּסֶף וְלַנְּקֵבָה עֶרְכְּךָ שְׁלֹשֶׁת שְׁקָלִים כָּסֶף׃

verses.english: From sixty years old and upward, your valuation shall be fifteen shekels for a male and ten shekels for a female.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִבֶּן־שִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה אִם־זָכָר וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ חֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר שָׁקֶל וְלַנְּקֵבָה עֲשָׂרָה שְׁקָלִים׃

verses.english: If he is too poor for your valuation, one shall set him before the priest, and the priest shall value him. The priest shall value him according to what the hand of the one who vowed can afford.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־מָךְ הוּא מֵעֶרְכֶּךָ וְהֶעֱמִידוֹ לִפְנֵי הַכֹּהֵן וְהֶעֱרִיךְ אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן עַל־פִּי אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂיג יַד הַנֹּדֵר יַעֲרִיכֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: If it concerns an animal of a kind presented as an offering to YHWH, whatever one gives from it to YHWH shall be holy.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ מִמֶּנָּה קָרְבָּן לַיהוָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן מִמֶּנּוּ לַיהוָה יִהְיֶה־קֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: He shall not replace it or exchange it, good for bad or bad for good. If he does exchange animal for animal, both it and its substitute shall be holy.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יַחֲלִיפֶנּוּ וְלֹא־יָמִיר אֹתוֹ טוֹב בְּרָע אוֹ־רַע בְּטוֹב וְאִם־הָמֵר יָמִיר בְּהֵמָה בִּבְהֵמָה וְהָיָה־הוּא וּתְמוּרָתוֹ יִהְיֶה־קֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: If it concerns any unclean animal of a kind not presented as an offering to YHWH, he shall set the animal before the priest.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם כָּל־בְּהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יַקְרִיבוּ מִמֶּנָּה קָרְבָּן לַיהוָה וְהֶעֱמִיד אֶת־הַבְּהֵמָה לִפְנֵי הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: The priest shall value it, whether good or bad. As you, the priest, value it, so it shall be.
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱרִיךְ הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָהּ בֵּין טוֹב וּבֵין רָע כְּעֶרְכְּךָ הַכֹּהֵן כֵּן יִהְיֶה׃

verses.english: If he does redeem it, he shall add a fifth to your valuation.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־גָּאֹל יִגְאָלֶנָּה וְיָסַף חֲמִישִׁתוֹ עַל־עֶרְכֶּךָ׃

verses.english: If a man consecrates his house as holy to YHWH, the priest shall value it, whether good or bad. As the priest values it, so it shall stand.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ כִּי־יַקְדִּשׁ אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָה וְהֶעֱרִיכוֹ הַכֹּהֵן בֵּין טוֹב וּבֵין רָע כַּאֲשֶׁר יַעֲרִיךְ אֹתוֹ הַכֹּהֵן כֵּן יָקוּם׃

verses.english: If the one who consecrated his house redeems it, he shall add a fifth of the silver of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־הַמַּקְדִּישׁ יִגְאַל אֶת־בֵּיתוֹ וְיָסַף חֲמִישִׁית כֶּסֶף־עֶרְכְּךָ עָלָיו וְהָיָה לוֹ׃

verses.english: If a man consecrates to YHWH part of the field of his possession, your valuation shall be according to its seed: fifty shekels of silver for an area sown with a homer of barley.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם מִשְּׂדֵה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ יַקְדִּישׁ אִישׁ לַיהוָה וְהָיָה עֶרְכְּךָ לְפִי זַרְעוֹ זֶרַע חֹמֶר שְׂעֹרִים בַּחֲמִשִּׁים שֶׁקֶל כָּסֶף׃

verses.english: If he consecrates his field from the year of Jubilee, it shall stand according to your valuation.
verses.hebrew: אִם־מִשְּׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל יַקְדִּישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ כְּעֶרְכְּךָ יָקוּם׃

verses.english: If he consecrates his field after the Jubilee, the priest shall calculate the silver for him according to the years remaining until the year of Jubilee, and a deduction shall be made from your valuation.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־אַחַר הַיֹּבֵל יַקְדִּישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ וְחִשַּׁב־לוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף עַל־פִּי הַשָּׁנִים הַנּוֹתָרֹת עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְנִגְרַע מֵעֶרְכֶּךָ׃

verses.english: If the one who consecrated the field redeems it, he shall add a fifth of the silver of your valuation to it, and it shall be confirmed as his.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־גָּאֹל יִגְאַל אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶה הַמַּקְדִּישׁ אֹתוֹ וְיָסַף חֲמִשִׁית כֶּסֶף־עֶרְכְּךָ עָלָיו וְקָם לוֹ׃

verses.english: If he does not redeem the field, and if he sells the field to another man, it shall no longer be redeemed.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא יִגְאַל אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶה וְאִם־מָכַר אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶה לְאִישׁ אַחֵר לֹא יִגָּאֵל עוֹד׃

verses.english: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it shall be holy to YHWH like a devoted field. It shall become the priest’s possession.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַשָּׂדֶה בְּצֵאתוֹ בַיֹּבֵל קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָה כִּשְׂדֵה הַחֵרֶם לַכֹּהֵן תִּהְיֶה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: If he consecrates to YHWH a field he purchased, which is not part of the field of his inherited possession,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם אֶת־שְׂדֵה מִקְנָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִשְּׂדֵה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ יַקְדִּישׁ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: the priest shall calculate for him the amount of the valuation until the year of Jubilee, and he shall give the valuation on that day as holy to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְחִשַּׁב־לוֹ הַכֹּהֵן אֵת מִכְסַת הָעֶרְכְּךָ עַד שְׁנַת הַיֹּבֵל וְנָתַן אֶת־הָעֶרְכְּךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: In the year of Jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom he bought it, to whom the possession of the land belongs.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל יָשׁוּב הַשָּׂדֶה לַאֲשֶׁר קָנָהוּ מֵאִתּוֹ לַאֲשֶׁר־לוֹ אֲחֻזַּת הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Every valuation of yours shall be by the sanctuary shekel; the shekel shall be twenty gerahs.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־עֶרְכְּךָ יִהְיֶה בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה יִהְיֶה הַשָּׁקֶל׃

verses.english: But no one may consecrate a firstborn animal that already belongs to YHWH by being firstborn. Whether ox or sheep, it belongs to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּכוֹר אֲשֶׁר־יְבֻכַּר לַיהוָה בִּבְהֵמָה לֹא־יַקְדִּישׁ אִישׁ אֹתוֹ אִם־שׁוֹר אִם־שֶׂה לַיהוָה הוּא׃

verses.english: If it is an unclean animal, he shall ransom it according to your valuation and add a fifth to it. If it is not redeemed, it shall be sold according to your valuation.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בַּבְּהֵמָה הַטְּמֵאָה וּפָדָה בְעֶרְכֶּךָ וְיָסַף חֲמִשִׁתוֹ עָלָיו וְאִם־לֹא יִגָּאֵל וְנִמְכַּר בְּעֶרְכֶּךָ׃

verses.english: But any devoted thing that a man devotes to YHWH from all that he has—human being, animal, or field of his possession—shall neither be sold nor redeemed. Every devoted thing is most holy to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־כָּל־חֵרֶם אֲשֶׁר יַחֲרִם אִישׁ לַיהוָה מִכָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ מֵאָדָם וּבְהֵמָה וּמִשְּׂדֵה אֲחֻזָּתוֹ לֹא יִמָּכֵר וְלֹא יִגָּאֵל כָּל־חֵרֶם קֹדֶשׁ־קָדָשִׁים הוּא לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: No person devoted to destruction from among humankind may be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־חֵרֶם אֲשֶׁר יָחֳרַם מִן־הָאָדָם לֹא יִפָּדֶה מוֹת יוּמָת׃

verses.english: Every tithe of the land, from the seed of the land or the fruit of the tree, belongs to YHWH; it is holy to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־מַעְשַׂר הָאָרֶץ מִזֶּרַע הָאָרֶץ מִפְּרִי הָעֵץ לַיהוָה הוּא קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: If a man redeems any of his tithe, he shall add a fifth to it.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־גָּאֹל יִגְאַל אִישׁ מִמַּעַשְׂרוֹ חֲמִשִׁיתוֹ יֹסֵף עָלָיו׃

verses.english: Every tithe of the herd and flock, every animal that passes under the staff—the tenth shall be holy to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־מַעְשַׂר בָּקָר וָצֹאן כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲבֹר תַּחַת הַשָּׁבֶט הָעֲשִׂירִי יִהְיֶה־קֹּדֶשׁ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, and he shall not exchange it. If he does exchange it, both it and its substitute shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יְבַקֵּר בֵּין־טוֹב לָרַע וְלֹא יְמִירֶנּוּ וְאִם־הָמֵר יְמִירֶנּוּ וְהָיָה־הוּא וּתְמוּרָתוֹ יִהְיֶה־קֹדֶשׁ לֹא יִגָּאֵל׃

verses.english: These are the commandments that YHWH commanded Moses for the sons of Israel on Mount Sinai.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַמִּצְוֺת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהַר סִינָי׃
